jobs.title: NOW HIRING: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Full\-Time 10AM\-6PM: M\-F\| School\-Year Position \| Competitive Pay \| FORXA Inc.**

Are you a natural leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment? Can you hold high standards while building a strong, supportive team? If you're organized, decisive, and passionate about making a difference for students, we'd love to meet you.

At FORXA Inc., our Enrichment Program Lead oversees high\-quality after\-school enrichment programs while supporting instructors, building relationships with school administration, and ensuring every student has an exceptional experience.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the primary daily point of contact with principals, assistant principals, and management.
* Coordinate and adjust daily program schedules as needed.
* Assign, reassign, and manage instructor placements.
* Address daily staff absences by phone and coordinate coverage.
* Monitor student behavior and implement appropriate interventions.
* Communicate professionally with parents regarding student concerns.
* Conduct regular instructor evaluations and provide coaching and accountability.
* Observe classrooms daily to ensure instructional quality and company standards are met.
* Maintain accurate student enrollment and attendance records.
* Oversee inventory and ensure materials are properly accounted for.
* Lead weekly staff meetings and maintain clear communication with the team.
* Make confident, timely decisions to keep programs running smoothly.

**We're Looking For Someone Who**

* Has a Bachelor's degree or is near completion of one.
* Is highly organized and detail\-oriented—you can organize just about anything, from a simple notebook to a complex spreadsheet.
* Is tech\-savvy and comfortable learning new software and systems.
* Is physically active and able to move quickly throughout multiple classrooms and campuses.
* Is a strong motivator who can inspire a team while maintaining accountability.
* Can confidently enforce policies and company standards when necessary while also supporting and developing staff.
* Understands that students always come first, above personal opinions or agendas.
* Is an exceptional multitasker who performs well under pressure.
* Maintains a professional appearance, wears the company uniform, and models expectations for the team.
* Has a proactive, go\-getter attitude and willingly goes above and beyond.
* Is available throughout the entire school calendar year, including peak operational periods. Vacation requests during high\-demand program periods are not permitted.
* Is prepared to commit to a one\-year employment agreement.

**The Ideal Candidate**

Our Leads do more than teach—they create engaging classrooms, build positive relationships, and help students develop confidence, creativity, and life skills through enrichment programs. You are confident, decisive, and solution\-oriented. You don't wait to be told what needs to be done—you anticipate challenges, communicate effectively, and take action. You know when to be firm, when to coach, and how to maintain a positive team culture without compromising expectations.

If you're ready to lead with purpose and help create outstanding enrichment experiences for students, we encourage you to apply today.

Pay: $24\.00 \- $26\.50 per hour

Expected hours: 35\.0 per week

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Working with children: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* Spanish \& English (Required)

Shift availability:

* Day Shift (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (After School Leadership Acdemy)
jobs.description:
**Job Title: ASLA Coordinator**

**HOW THIS ROLE SUPPORTS THE MISSION**

EOYDC’s After School Leadership Academy (ASLA) provides resources for K\-5 students to develop in the areas of academics, leadership, and character. Under the direction of the ASLA Manager, the ASLA Coordinator is responsible for coordinating all aspects of the ASLA program. These duties include, but are not limited to, supporting the design of ASLA curriculum, implementing lesson plans, training and managing the ASLA Youth Leader interns, assessing program outcomes, and building/maintaining relationships with participants, families, and partner schools.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

This role will collaborate across the organization, sometimes as the lead of a project and sometimes as support. The person in this role will be responsible for ensuring the success of the following:

* Development and facilitation of lessons, activities, field trips, and events that are consistent with the mission of the program for students in grades K\-5
* Creation and adjustment of weekly program schedule in consideration of partner school schedules and organization\-wide events
* ASLA student engagement
* Provide instruction based on engaging lesson plans developed to strengthen academic performance, enhance leadership skills, and develop character
* Supervise children and promote safety and respect amongst all participants
* Identify student academic and behavioral strengths and challenges, and work with the ASLA Manager and team to create appropriate plan to address their unique needs
* Work closely with students’ teachers and families to promote academic success
* Provide students with direct support to promote emotional/psychological health and development
* Establish two way communication channels to facilitate ongoing engagement with participants’ parents, guardians, and educators

**WHO YOU WILL WORK CLOSELY WITH**

This role is part of the ASLA Team, which works directly with EOYDC’s K\-5 students. Specifically, the following people will work directly with you to support your work:

* Manager: ASLA Manager
* Your manager will help guide your work and be an advocate for you amongst senior leadership. They will also, with input from the Chief Program Officer, help you set the objectives and vision for the various activities that you will lead.
* Team Members: ASLA Coaches and Youth Leaders
* The Youth Leaders will work directly with the students on a daily basis and will provide you support by leading or supporting the activities that you plan
* The Coaches will support you as an additional layer of accountability for the youth leaders and will also provide support for large events

**WHO \& WHAT YOU WILL SUPPORT**

EOYDC’s collaborative culture means that everyone supports one another in achieving the organization’s goals. These are some of the ways you will support work that is led by others on the team:

* The ASLA Manager in:
* Identifying opportunities for program and process improvement
* Providing Intern and Staff support
* Provide supervision, guidance, resources, and feedback to ASLA Coaches and Youth Leaders
* Assist with the regular training ASLA Youth Leaders receiving in order to facilitate growth in the areas of classroom management, tutoring/instruction, leadership, early childhood development, parent engagement, and other key success factors
* Reinforce program policies and procedures through role modeling, coaching, and performance management
* Assessment \& Reporting
* Maintain an individual development plan documenting goals, observations, learning outcomes, and progress for each student
* Maintain program attendance records and OFCY
* Provide insight to ASLA Manager on Program Monthly Reports
* Work with ASLA Manager to facilitate collection of program data for grant reporting purposes
* **Additional duties as required**
* EOYDC is a community\-based organization, and that community spirit shows up in how we work with each other. There may be times that are considered “all hands on deck,” and all team members are expected to jump in and support.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and experience equivalent to:

* Participation in/completion of a specialized program and/or pursuing a certification or degree in education, child development, or a related field strongly preferred
* At least 3 years working directly with elementary school and/or middle school students\-\-strong preference for at least one of those years being primary lead for classroom management and/or program coordination
* Demonstrated commitment to serving systematically marginalized communities with dignity and respect
* Highly organized with strong time\-management
* Must be patient, flexible, responsible, and enjoy being with students
* Must be available to work between 25\-30 hours per week, primarily on\-site during regular program hours
* Non\-profit experience preferred
* Bilingual Spanish/English a plus

**COMPENSATION**

This is a part\-time, temporary hourly position (25\-30 hours/week). The compensation is $23\-$27 hourly (depending on experience) \+ excellent benefits including health (health plan 100% employer\-paid), dental and retirement (starting 30% 403b match).

**OUR COMMITMENT TO BELONGING, DIGNITY, JUSTICE, AND JOY**

Located in a primarily Black and Brown community grappling with decades of systemic oppression, EOYDC is committed to advancing racial and socioeconomic equity and justice in all that we do. EOYDC intentionally cultivates a climate in which young people feel a sense of belonging, dignity, and joy. Key to this is fostering a relational, healing\-centered, culturally sustaining approach, while centering those most systematically marginalized.

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION**

The East Oakland Youth Development Center (EOYDC)’s mission is to nurture the holistic development of youth from kindergarten into adulthood so that they can live a life of prosperity, integrity, and purpose. Celebrating 47 years of ground\-breaking prog

jobs.title: Community Health Worker III
jobs.description:
**Overall Summary:**


The Community Health Worker III (CHW III) at Bay Area Community Health will primarily work at serving and assisting our patients while located at different sites throughout the organization and community in both Alameda and Santa Clara Counties. CHW III will work at different capacities based on their assigned area of training and specialty. The CHW III will be a trusted member of the community, and actively participate as a liaison between primary care, specialties and resources available to BACH patients. Activities may include, but are not limited to, outreach, engagement, care coordination, case management, linkage of the patient with resources at BACH and in the community such as food, housing, financial and transportation assistance and linking the patient to brick and mortar sites.


**Essential Responsibilities:**


The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks and responsibilities. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.* Under the general direction of the supervisor/manager, the Community Health Worker performs a variety of services. Duties include:

* CHW, I and II tasks, plus:
* Coordinate and deliver training for CHW I through CHW II
* Schedule staff for other external or online training
* Prepare and deliver presentations
* Assess patient’s home living situation
* Conduct housing and crisis assessments in various portals, as applicable
* Conduct SDOH assessments and provide resources as appropriate
* Conduct intake assessment of clients referred for case management
* Monitor, document, and report staff productivity through internal and external reports
* Assist in monitoring of patient referrals
* Utilize PDSA model for continuous process improvement
* Develop and nurture collaborative relationships with community partners
* Ensure compliance with health plan, county grant, or specific program requirements
* Support patient engagement, linkage, coordination, monitoring, follow\-up and advocacy
* Promote integrated care among primary care providers and specialties
* Perform general administration duties
* Adhere to all HIPAA rules and regulations
* Adhere to the policy and procedures of BACH
* Conduct file reviews to maintain compliance of program.
* Assist with providing training and development to support staff in meeting their expectations.
* Respond to requests for information, researches, resolves complex problems, and prepares correspondence of a sensitive and/or confidential nature.
* Ensure program participant compliance with all applicable rules, regulations, standards, and policies and procedures.
* Develop and periodically update an inventory of available resources for patients.
* Establish a pool of partners and networks that would facilitate access to resources and programs for eligible patients.
* Work flexible hours, which includes some evenings and weekends
* Work at any of BACH location, including clinics, mobiles, schools, homeless encampments, warming centers and patients’ homes, or patient appointments as assigned

**Secondary Responsibilities:**

* Attends workshops, training, and meetings as needed, and as requested
* Assists with mentoring, training, information and providing guidance to team members.
* Assists with the review, interpretation, determination of impact, and implementation of program regulation and services, and recommends improvements.
* Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor

**Qualifications:**




**Required Education, Experience, and Training:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* 2\-4 years of experience in a community\-based health care service capacity preferred
* AS/AA in health or related field preferred
* Bilingual preferred
* CEC Certification, if applicable
* CHW Certification \- Recertification and/or retraining process, as required

**Work Conditions:**

* Travel to other sites and/or locations required.
* Work outside in varying temperatures and work conditions.
* Prolonged periods of walking, standing or sitting.

**Physical Demands:**


This position requires:

* Sitting, walking, and standing in a typical medical/clinical office environment.
* Extended and/or prolonged periods of sitting, walking, or standing.
* Regular bending, stretching, and lifting up to 50 pounds.
* Regularly reaching with arms, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling while performing job duties.
* Moderate exposure to unusual elements, such as extreme temperatures, dirt, dust, fumes, smoke, unpleasant odors, and/or loud noises.
* Manual dexterity for tasks involving standard office equipment and computer keyboard, including repetitive movements such as typing.
* Traveling to work sites, including exposure to outside elements.
* Exposure to potentially dangerous materials, hazards, physical risks and situations, requiring adherence to extensive safety precautions and possibly the use of protective equipment.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**


None

jobs.title: Supply Chain Training Manager
jobs.description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE


Join Our Community of Food People!


The Supply Chain Training Manager is responsible for overseeing the entirety of Supply Chain onboarding and training (classroom, on\-the\-job, train the trainer, etc.), with emphasis on new\-hire’s (Selectors \& Drivers) first 90\-days. The Supply Chain Training Manager contributes to the continuous improvement of safety, performance standards, ongoing engagement, and retention for new Selectors and Drivers through the implementation of learning and performance solutions (feedback, coaching, mentorship programs) within Supply Chain operations.  

  

In conjunction with Market Operations Leaders, this role mentors lead trainers \& new hires during a multi\-week training program and is responsible for overseeing the assimilation, onboarding, and assessment of new talent. The Supply Chain Training Manager leads, supervises, and conducts associate training needs analysis and identifies opportunities to improve Supply Chain safety, productivity, and retention using observations, data \& analytics, and feedback.**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Owns execution of warehouse training (classroom \& on\-the\-job) for new Selectors \& Drivers during the first 90\-days of employment through coaching and mentoring Selector and Driver Trainers and when necessary and delivery training.
* Leads a team of Supply Chain Trainers \& New Hires through a multi\-week onboarding period (first 90 days) as measured by various indicators (productivity, quality, reliability, safety, culture integration, job knowledge, retention).
* Directs and coordinates all aspects of onboarding and training including scheduling/assigning resources, conducting classroom \& on\-the\-job training when Selector/Driver trainers are not available, performing observations, acting as SME on process \& milestones and metric tracking/success measurements.
* Provides actionable performance, behavioral feedback and coaching in both classroom and on\-the\-job environments to trainers and new hires.
* Facilitates mentoring of new Selectors \& Drivers to drive engagement through the onboarding process.
* Analyzes and tracks weekly Trainer’s \& Associate’s performance (30/60/90\-day milestones) to ensure expectations are met.
* Collects data to determine safety, effectiveness, retention, and sustainability of training for the continuous improvement of the program.
* Ensures both new and existing Associates are safely following preferred plays while meeting productivity goals.
* Partners with Vice President Operations, Directors, HR, and Supervisors/Managers to regularly check progress and performance of new selectors to uncover coaching opportunities and identify steps to improve performance.
* Actively attends and participates in all required routines including but not limited to: UMOS steering, labor planning, and others.
* Reports performance and retention data to HR and L\&D while providing training recommendations and strategies based on trends.
* May consult in the interview, hire, performance review, discipline, and termination process in collaboration with the Vice President of Operations \& HR to ensure all training needs are aligned, relevant, and delivered as expected (as needed).
* Regularly inspects facility for safety hazards and either resolves them or reports them to the safety manager as appropriate. Jointly accountable (with warehouse leadership) for maintaining the physical condition of the warehouse and its equipment.
* Performs all assigned duties for area markets, as needed/requested, which may require travel.
* Performs other duties as assigned by manager.

 **SUPERVISION**:

* Direct supervision of all Selector and Driver New Hires (\~20 new hires at any given time) during their onboarding (Day 1 – Day 90\).
* Market on\-the\-job Trainers, where applicable.

 **RELATIONSHIPS**

* **Internal:** VPO, Directors, HR, and Supervisors/Managers, and Supply Chain Associates
* **External**: Training course vendors and regulatory compliance agencies, as applicable

 **WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Inside/Outside of Distribution Centers, exposure to heat \& cold (freezer \& cooler)
* Internal Associate facing
* Travel via air \& car (rental)

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Two years of training/facilitation experience
* One year experience overseeing a workforce
* Strong leadership, communication, and people development skills

 **Education**

* High School diploma or equivalent

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* College degree
* Training/facilitation experience in a Supply Chain and/or Warehouse environment
* Prior experience and/or leadership/direct supervision in a Supply Chain/Warehouse environment
* Strong facilitation, leadership, communication, engagement, and development skills
* Ability to compile and interpret operational metrics
* Broad knowledge of warehouse operations, methods, and procedures
* Strong computer skills with proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Access
* Familiarity with inventory control, OSHA, HAACP and other regulatory requirements
* PIT experience

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations Manager

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal® is hiring an Operations Manager. The Operations Manager is a central leader in ensuring successful delivery of security services across assigned client sites. This role oversees frontline hiring, staffing, scheduling, training, and operational compliance while serving as a critical support and escalation point for employees and clients. The Operations Manager will champion high‑quality service, workforce stability, and operational consistency by proactively addressing performance concerns, maintaining contractual staffing levels, and building strong client relationships Why Join Allied Universal?
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
Selection and Placement* Manage the selection and placement process for new security professionals, including first\-line supervisors; design and implement career development and performance improvement plans; evaluate low\-performing employees for replacement, upgrade or transfer
* Make initial job offers (for new employees) and job transfers (for existing employees) using company forms and procedures, offering rates, schedules and benefits in alignment with post contract requirements; maintain and publish weekly Open Post List and actively manage job openings within division/branch


Schedule and Workforce Management* Create, modify and manage post schedules in WinTeam to ensure adequate coverage at all times; ensure schedules are properly maintained in WinTeam and are updated regularly
* Ensure all positions are staffed according to contract requirements and effectively manage branch overtime through proper scheduling and staffing; maintain a qualified, sufficient pool of flex personnel for backfill of vacant positions as needed
* Maintain regular proactive contact with Security Professionals to ensure all staff is being effectively utilized, properly trained, and ready for placement as needed. Review “No Hours Report” with branch Human Resource staff on a weekly basis, and disposition employees who are on “active” status with no hours, in accordance with company policies, ensuring no employees remain on “no hours” status beyond 3 weeks


Payroll Management* Receive weekly timesheets and update WinTeam schedules as necessary (verify such for self\-scheduling accounts); run weekly payroll according to company procedures. Ensure records are properly maintained and updated to reduce payroll errors; resolve payroll discrepancies in a timely and efficient manner, and communicate status of such to affected employees, to minimize financial exposure for Company
* Follow all company policies regarding timekeeping procedures, meal and rest period breaks (where applicable), ensuring signatures and acknowledgements are properly documented (where applicable), and conducting weekly audits of timekeeping records to ensure accuracy
* Process requests for final paychecks, anniversary bonuses and other pay related issues, and execute the distribution of such pay; act as a Company representative in such matters as unemployment hearings, workers’ compensation hearings/depositions, union meetings (where applicable), state agency activities, depositions, and other related liability matters


Employee Relations* Conduct disciplinary and counseling sessions with Security Professionals as needed in a proactive and professional manner. Ensure all such issues are documented according to company standards, and that all issues receive proper follow up for resolution
* Initiate termination procedures as needed for voluntary and involuntary separations; execute termination meetings as necessary and complete all follow up documentation according to company standards
* Maintain high employee morale and low employee turnover through effective and proactive communications and timely problem resolution; ensure all hiring, counseling, disciplinary and termination procedures are executed in a consistent manner
* Ensure a smooth running operation by enforcing post specific policies and procedures through proper communication and training; may utilize field training staff to assist in executing post\-specific training

**QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):*** High School diploma or equivalent
* Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle in the course of conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
* Minimum of three (3\) years of leadership experience in a high\-volume workforce environment, preferably in the protective service industry
* Work experience in successfully building and developing teams
* Leadership skills that foster teamwork, innovation, agility, client relations and achieving desired results
* Ability to maintain a profitable book of business by cross\-collaborating and utilizing results\-oriented problem\-solving skills to meet both client and employee growth and satisfaction
* Proficiency in web\-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office and (BI) Business Intelligence tools for metrics analysis, reporting, automation, and presentations
* Dynamic networking skills displaying a commitment to safety and trust by participating in local community, client and industry events
* Basic understanding of financial principles, including budgeting and financial reporting; ability to interpret simple financial data and use it to support decision\-making

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):*** College degree in criminal justice, business administration

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
***About the role:***


The Operations Manager is responsible for reducing risk, responding to incidents, and limiting exposure to liability within the client Global Safety \& Security operations. The Operations Manager will partner with the client Global Safety \& Security Management team to develop, implement and manage physical security, safety, executive protection, special events, investigations and risk management programs that align with the client culture, values and policies. The Operations Manager reports directly to the Director of Operations.  



***In this role, your responsibilities will be:***

* Design, develop, implement, and manage physical security operations for the client including post orders, standards, policies, and procedures
* Maintain close coordination, planning, communication and regular direct liaison with the client Global Safety \& Security management team and SIS Executive team around all aspects of physical security, safety, executive protection, special events, investigations and risk management programs
* Manage operations at local client campus including budget management, performance metrics and contract management
* Responsible for identifying areas of program improvement, expansions of service, customer service improvements and other evolutionary changes
* Create measurable reporting process to include alarm monitoring, incident response, tracking and reporting of performance metrics and other service areas
* Respond in a timely manner to emergent events, issues, staffing deficiencies, and client requests
* Perform other related duties as required

***As a candidate you must have:***

* Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, emergency management, business management, or related discipline or equivalent
* Five plus years experience in safety and security management or supervision, law enforcement or military, or security control room supervision
* ASIS Certified Protection Professional (CPP) and/or Physical Security Professional (PSP)
* Proficient in PC and iOS hardware and software, including word processing, data analysis, Lenel, Salesforce
* Complete and maintain state guard certification as prescribed by presiding state law, as well as all client requested certification; all documentation and fees are the responsibility of the employee unless otherwise noted
* Must be a dependable team player with business maturity and enthusiasm with the ability to deliver high level of customer service
* Have flexibility to work any shifts on any day of the week (Mon\-Sun) and willingness to assist the team when needed

  

***We offer:***  

* Health, Dental, Vision, and 401k for eligible employees
* Paid Time Off including Sick/Safe Time
* A dynamic and challenging work environment with opportunity for growth

  

**Security Industry Specialists, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Influencer Marketing
jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesMarketing and CommunicationsID: 42920
  
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.


At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.


A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're looking for a Manager of Influencer Marketing to build and scale the operational backbone of our global influencer program. This is not a traditional campaign role — you'll be the person who turns creator relationships and regional programs into a repeatable, data\-driven machine. You'll own the systems, playbooks, and tools that allow our influencer marketing team to operate efficiently at scale across markets and content types.



This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and program operations, and is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, loves building things from scratch, and is energized by the challenge of bringing structure to a fast\-moving space.


**You will:**
-------------


**Program Operations \& Scale**


* Design and manage the operational infrastructure for a global influencer program spanning multiple content types, markets, and campaign types
* Partner with web systems team to manage front\-end, creator facing authenticated portal as well as back\-end systems
* Build scalable workflows in our CRM system for influencer sourcing, contracting, onboarding, activation, and reporting — reducing manual lift while increasing output
* Define and maintain program standards, SLAs, and intake processes across internal stakeholders and external partners
* Partner with legal, finance, and other internal and external partners to streamline contracting and payment operations globally


**Global Playbooks**


* Develop and maintain a suite of global playbooks covering influencer program application management, relationship tiering, campaign briefing, content guidelines, and performance benchmarking
* Localize frameworks for regional teams while preserving global consistency in brand standards and measurement methodology
* Establish best practices for new program verticals (e.g., live events, product launches, always\-on ambassador programs) and codify learnings into repeatable resources
* Train and enable cross\-functional partners and regional teams on playbook adoption


**CRM \& Tooling**


* Lead the buildout of a centralized influencer CRM and creator\-facing portal — defining data architecture, contact management standards, tagging taxonomy, and relationship history tracking
* Build, evaluate, implement, and own influencer marketing technology (CRM platforms, discovery tools, reporting dashboards) and serve as the internal subject matter expert

jobs.title: Assistant Critical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY:**


STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award\-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost\-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience.


STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK.

**THE POSITION:**


STACK is looking for an Assistant Critical Operations Manager (ACOM) to support a local data center campus. As a leader in STACK’s Critical Operations team, the ACOM must possess an expert level of knowledge and will be responsible for assisting the Critical Operations Manager in maintaining the mechanical, electrical, fire life safety, base building, and other various internal data center systems. The ACOM will also be focused on the implementation of programs related to Safety, Team, Availability, Communication, and Knowledge. The Assistant Critical Operations Manager will report to the Critical Operations Manager.


The ACOM is responsible for the implementation of the Data Center Operations Program at their site and is responsible for employee training and ensuring all staff is adequately qualified to perform their duties. Holding regular team meetings and individual 1:1 sessions is required. The ACOM will assist the Critical Operations Manager in developing and maintaining CAPEX and OPEX budgets at the site level. They will also be responsible for project execution and management including developing scopes, obtaining proposals, creating purchase requisitions, and ensuring invoices are routed properly.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Lead and implement a standardized culture of always working safely across all STACK data centers.
* Serve as a datacenter subject matter expert for electrical, mechanical, fire life safety, and other data center systems.
* Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions within the facility.
* Implement site\-level efficiency projects and maintain overall site design PUE.
* Ensure STACK preventative and predictive maintenance program is executed.
* Train and mentor junior staff.
* Manage vendor relationships and service contracts.
* Assist in managing vendor procurement and billing processes.
* Support site budgeting and forecasting for both CapEx and OpEx.
* Create highly detailed technical procedures for maintenance events, emergency situations, and standard site evolutions.
* Perform expert technical review of procedures, company standards, and policies.
* Manage site audits, both internal and external, ensuring adherence to compliance standards.
* Manage systems to avoid unplanned, customer\-impacting outages.
* Manage the data floor and back\-of\-house mechanical loading capacity to ensure cooling system efficiency.
* Navigate and utilize CMS, EPMS, and BMS systems.
* Provide day\-to\-day exceptional customer service and support.
* Be available on\-call as required to respond to emergency situations at the data center.
* Perform other duties as required by STACK. Job duties, roles, and responsibilities are subject to change over time.

**THE DETAILS:**

* **Location: San Jose, CA**
* **Travel:** None or less than 5%
* **Benefits:** Healthcare, Dental Care, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Paid Leave Programs
* Must be eligible to work in the United States
* Must pass comprehensive background and drug screening

**MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum of 4–5 years' experience in a data center or other related mission critical operations role
* Knowledge of data center (hyperscale, enterprise, and colocation) and telecommunications industries
* Experience working with Microsoft Office applications and database software
* 3–5 years' experience managing facility preventative maintenance programs
* 3–5 years' experience in vendor and project management
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and perform well in stressful situations
* Expert understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., UPS, Transformers, PDUs, RPPs, Chillers, CRAH, CRAC, STS, ATS, Pre\-action systems)
* Expert knowledge of NFPA70e, NFPA72, NFPA25, and fire life safety compliance standards
* Experience in data center trending and analysis with ability to learn PC\-based monitoring systems
* Proficiency in data center commissioning standards
* Ability to perform physical tasks including standing, walking, climbing, and lifting up to 25 pounds
* Willingness to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, and on\-call support
* Comfortable working in a high\-stress, fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities

**Compensation Range:**

$73\.00 \- $76\.50**THIS MIGHT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF:**

* You are a strong communicator, you are persuasive and clear, blending analytics with experience in decision\-making.
* You do not get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple priorities while balancing urgent requests with shifting timelines and deliverables.
* You are a team builder. You take the time to understand and develop the strengths of your resources while formulating long\-term plans for the growth and success of the team.
* You are naturally curious and driven toward continual improvement. While you celebrate your successes, you take time to review and analyze campaigns for future learning.

**WHY STACK?**

* We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, flexible spending accounts – even a cell phone subsidy.
* We foster a culture of appreciation, including peer\-to\-peer recognition and rewards programs.
* Fun is part of our DN

The Protective Services Operations Manager \- Northern California is responsible for the hands\-on management of the Company's residential security accounts and executive protection assignments throughout Northern California, with primary responsibility for the San Francisco Bay Area. This position owns day\-to\-day service delivery, staffing, field supervision, quality control, and client communication for the assigned portfolio.

This is a working management position requiring regular field presence and direct involvement in account launches, site visits, staffing challenges, training, advances, and time\-sensitive protection assignments. When management demand permits, the Manager may personally support billable executive protection assignments, advances, training, or emergency coverage. Success is measured by service quality, staffing stability, client satisfaction, field engagement, responsiveness, and financial performance.

**Operational \& Account Management:**

* Manage the day\-to\-day performance of assigned residential security accounts and protective services operations.
* Maintain direct awareness of staffing, scheduling, post activity, incidents, client expectations, and open operational issues.
* Review schedules, overtime, callouts, and deployment practices each week to ensure reliable coverage and efficient use of personnel.

**Rate of Pay:** $28 per hour

**About XL Event Lab**

XL Event Lab is an international live events company producing a portfolio of successful

touring entertainment experiences across multiple markets.

As we continue to expand across North America, we're looking for an Event Operations

Manager to help deliver exceptional live events throughout California (Bay Area/San Jose).

**The Role**

Reporting to the Head of Regional Development – Live Events, you'll take responsibility

for the operational delivery of our events once venues have been secured. From planning

and preparation through to the final guest leaving the venue, you'll ensure every event is

delivered safely, professionally and to an exceptional standard.

This is a practical, hands\-on role. You'll lead Event Crew, transport equipment, liaise with

venues, solve problems as they arise and ensure every event delivers a first\-class guest

experience.

If you enjoy leading people, thrive in fast\-paced environments and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, we'd love to hear from you.

***What You'll Be Doing***

**Event Delivery**

* Lead the operational delivery of live events across your region.
* Act as the operational lead on event day.
* Ensure events run safely, efficiently and on schedule.
* Resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.

**Venue Operations**

* Take ownership of venue operations following contract confirmation.
* Liaise directly with venue staff before and during each event.
* Ensure all operational requirements are in place ahead of every event.

**Team Leadership**

* Schedule Event Crew for upcoming events.
* Lead pre\-event briefings and provide direction throughout each event.
* Foster a positive, professional team environment.

**Equipment \& Logistics**

* Transport event equipment to and from venues using a U\-Haul vehicle.
* Manage event setup and pack\-down.
* Maintain equipment and monitor inventory levels.

**Guest Experience**

* Deliver an outstanding customer experience from arrival through to departure.
* Handle guest queries and resolve issues professionally.
* Represent XL Event Lab and our event brands to the highest standard.

**About You**

You'll be organised, dependable and comfortable taking responsibility for live events.

Previous experience in live events would be advantageous, but we'd also welcome

candidates from hospitality, visitor attractions, theatres, tourism or similar customer\-facing

environments.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working as part of a team, take pride in delivering exceptional

experiences and remain calm under pressure.

**Working Pattern**

This role is centered around our live event schedule.

Most work takes place on Fridays and Saturdays, with occasional Thursday and Sunday

events depending on the tour schedule. Hours will average between 16\-30 each week.

Regular travel throughout California is required, with overnight stays only occasionally

necessary.

**Why Join XL Event Lab?**

* Join an established international live events company.
* Play a key role in delivering memorable live experiences.
* Work in a varied, hands\-on role where no two event days are the same.
* Become part of a growing business with ambitious plans across North America.

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Medsien** is the leading provider of scalable remote care management for a quality patient experience. Hundreds of organizations trust Medsien's unparalleled technology solutions to implement exceptional remote care management programs, personalize every interaction, and improve the lives of the people who need it most. Based in San Francisco and venture\-backed by top\-tier investors, Medsien was founded to reimagine remote care management.



More than 60% of all U.S. adults\-over 150 million people\-live with at least one chronic condition, which requires dedicated, ongoing medical support outside the four walls of their doctor's office. And yet, only 20% of these patients have access to remote care from the comfort of their homes, putting their health at significant risk.



Our vision is to provide better access to care. We want to see a world where no chronic condition is an obstacle to a happy life.



We're seeking an experienced **Clinical Operations Manager** to work closely with senior leadership and lead a team of medical assistants and care coordinators, proactively supporting, developing, and improving processes across the clinical team. This position reports directly to the Director of Operations.



As the **Clinical Operations Manager**, you will:


* Directly manage a remote team of medical assistants, providing guidance, support, and regular feedback,
* Manage daily operations of clinical staff, including planning, goal setting, and quality assurance,
* Design and improve specific operational processes and guidelines to ensure high clinical quality and service excellence in patient care,
* Collaborate with the leadership and other stakeholders to implement policies and procedures and provide adequate oversight,
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators to measure success and engagement across different teams and with different external partners,
* Participate in hiring, training, and onboarding of new staff,
* Assign and delegate tasks to the medical assistants based on their expertise and workload, ensuring optimal resource utilization,
* Conduct performance evaluations, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching and training as needed,
* Develop and implement efficient workflows and processes to maximize the quality and efficiency of patient care.


**Please apply if you have:**


* Experience managing multiple departments or functions, preferably with responsibility for building those departments from the ground up,
* Experience building teams, processes, workflows, and SOPs rather than simply managing an established operation,
* Strong cross\-functional management experience and the ability to support multiple departments simultaneously,
* Demonstrated ability to identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions,
* Experience with resource allocation, staffing, capacity planning, and coverage across teams,
* Strong people\-management skills, including coaching managers and individual contributors,
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of problems without requiring significant direction,
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities,
* Experience using KPIs, metrics, and data to manage team performance and operational efficiency,
* Demonstrated process improvement experience with measurable results,
* 5\+ years of experience managing employees, including performance and day\-to\-day operational oversight in a clinical setting,
* Background in nursing, care management or clinical operations,
* Excellent communication skills,
* Strong organization and project management skills; ability to prioritize, organize, plan, and implement services as well as handle multiple projects/problems simultaneously,
* Desire to work at an early\-stage startup and comfort with associated uncertainty and rolling up your sleeves to get things done,
* Proficiency in HIPAA and CMS regulatory requirements,
* BA/BS degree,
* Residence in the US.


Some **nice\-to\-have** qualifications include experience in:


* Healthcare or clinical operations,
* Managing support, shared\-services, or operational enablement teams,
* Managing a float pool or shared staffing model,
* Scaling multiple departments during rapid growth,
* Implementing technology or automation to improve operational efficiency,
* Working in a startup or rapidly changing organization,
* Creating a new department or operational function from the ground up.


**For this position, we offer:**


* Competitive salary,
* Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage,
* Flexible vacation and PTO policies,
* Fully remote work opportunities,
* Training, mentorship, and coaching from leadership.


**Our Process**



We will review your application along with all the others we receive and pick the top profiles for a screening call. In many cases due to time constraints and our candidate volume, only the short\-listed candidates are contacted but we do consider each application carefully. If you have been selected as a short\-listed candidate, we will contact you for a short screening call to get to know you better. If you don't get a call, please don't be disappointed! We receive many applications for each role and must prioritize who we speak to.



Employment at **Medsien** is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.


**Thank you for taking the time to apply for a position at Medsien!**

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
With a network of nearly 200 branches, Loomis armored transportation, cash management centers, and cash inventory vaults keep cash flowing throughout financial institutions and retail businesses across the US. Loomis prides itself on providing employees with opportunities for career advancement and job satisfaction. In fact, many of our company’s managers, vice presidents, and corporate executives started out in the branches as driver/guards and tellers. Our work can be challenging, but the thousands who have stayed with our company for decades will tell you that if you have the desire to learn and the drive to succeed, Loomis is the place to be. Come join our team!
  
  

**Job Overview:** The Operations Supervisor will be responsible for implementing and administering Loomis policies and procedures, monitoring and controlling daily operations, and assisting with the long\-term operation of armored car routes and the cash vault. The Operations Supervisor will work alongside Management to develop, maintain, and supervise a professional, employee\-centered culture, a safe and secure operation, high service delivery, and cost\-effective, productive operations. This includes operational responsibility for all route operations (armored and ATM), and for vault and facility security operations, as directed by the Operations Manager/Branch Manager.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Complete and maintain scheduling/routing on a daily basis.
* Oversight and coordination of armored and ATM routes, dispatch, first\-line ATM maintenance, vault, and terminal operations.
* Maintaining effectiveness and efficiency of route, terminal, and vault operations.
* Safety of employees, vehicles, and facilities through training, monitoring, and enforcement of policies and procedures
* Security of cargo and terminal through training, monitoring, and enforcement of policies and procedures, including terminal opening and closing.
* Investigating accidents and processing required paperwork.
* Developing and maintaining customer service capabilities among all operations staff.
* Responding to customer inquiries and/or complaints and solving logistical issues.
* Coordinating with sales, other Division branches and departments, Division and corporate staff, other carriers, and vendors in creating and implementing viable operational solutions to new customers.
* Controlling overtime hours. Monitoring employee vacation schedules.
* Maintaining the effectiveness and efficiency of operational functions.
* Communication with all employees to immediately resolve any outstanding issues and/or complaints.
* Completion of any and all additional responsibilities that are assigned by the Operations Manager and/or other Management Team Members on an “as needed” basis.
* Provide leadership that is dedicated to professionalism, continuous improvement, and exceeding challenging goals and objectives.
* Recruiting, interviewing, testing, selecting, training, and supervising operations personnel.
* Oversight and coordination of maintenance of vehicles, forklifts, and other equipment.
* Emergency response, including response to employee injuries, facility security incidents, vehicle incidents, and security investigations.
* Manipulation and maintenance of route and vault data to include manual paperwork and electronic data.
* All other duties as assigned by the Operations Manager/Branch Manager.


**Primary Qualifications:**  

* Ability to obtain a valid firearms permit.
* Must have 3\+ years’ experience in transportation and warehousing, transportation logistics, or a related field.
* Minimum 2\+ years of proven professional supervisory and leadership experience.
* Experience in banking or retail cash and ATM operations preferred.
* Strong desire to succeed, advance your career, and work for a company\-leading branch.


**Individual Skills \& Competencies:**  

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage and develop high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to teach, coach, and present to small and large groups.
* Excellent computer skills and a working knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.


**Benefits:**  

Loomis offers one of the most comprehensive employee benefits packages in the industry, which includes:
  
* Vacation and Sick Time (PTO), as well as Paid Holidays
* Health \& Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Plan
* Basic Life Insurance Plan
* Voluntary Life Insurance Plan
* Flexible Spending and Health Savings Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Industry\-leading Training and Development


Loomis is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============


We are a small team that cares about deep thinking, speed, craftsmanship, and putting customers first. Our mission is to build the best care experience in healthcare, on a 30 year horizon.


We help physicians achieve independence by making it easier to start, operate, and grow their practices. We believe the future of healthcare will be driven by individual physicians, not by large bureaucratic systems. Lowering the barrier to practice ownership lets doctors deliver better care for everyone.


The founding team brings deep expertise across medicine, product, operations, and engineering, including more than 30 years of experience running independent practices across urgent care centers, surgical centers, and beyond. We have built 0\-to\-1 products at Meta, Dropbox, Instagram, Coda, and Nomad, and have founded companies with valuations exceeding $1B and more than 100M MAU.

**Highlights**
--------------

* We have strong product market fit. $15M\+ ARR in under 15 months.
* We are profitable and funded by top tier healthcare investors.
* We are about 30 people today and rapidly growing across the company.
* You will fit in here if you want to own a product, a process, or a function and take it from 1 to 100\.

**The Role**
------------


You will turn market strategy into execution across growth, physician operations, and business performance. You will work closely with physicians and frontline teams, solve operational problems, improve practice performance, and help build the systems needed to scale across the state.


This is a hands\-on role. You will move between analyzing performance, launching new initiatives, working directly with practices, and partnering with product and engineering to build better operational tools.


You will also help shape how we build AI\-native operations. That means rethinking workflows from first principles, identifying where automation can create leverage, and knowing where human judgment and relationships still matter.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own key growth and operational initiatives across California.
* Work directly with physicians and practice teams to identify problems and improve performance.
* Support the launch, ramp\-up, and growth of new physicians and practices.
* Use data to identify operational bottlenecks, growth opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Build repeatable processes and operating playbooks as the market scales.
* Identify opportunities to make workflows automated, AI\-assisted, or more efficient.
* Partner with product, engineering, and central teams to turn operational needs into scalable solutions.

**You Might Be a Fit If**
-------------------------

* You have 3–5 years of experience in operations, strategy, consulting, healthcare, startups, or another high\-growth environment.
* You can move seamlessly between strategy and hands\-on execution.
* You understand how to redesign operations around AI rather than simply add technology to existing processes.
* You have strong judgment about where automation creates leverage and where human involvement creates a better experience.
* You are a self\-starter who can develop a plan and execute it end to end.
* You are comfortable solving complex problems with limited structure or information.
* You have a roll\-up\-your\-sleeves approach and are willing to work directly with teams and customers.
* You move quickly, hold a high bar for quality, and take full ownership of results.
* You are a thoughtful, low\-ego teammate. We want to play long\-term games with long\-term people..

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Medical insurance through Blue Shield of California, with multiple PPO and HMO options
* Dental and vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO
* Lunch in the office
* Competitive equity package
* A high\-trust, low\-ego, high\-ownership culture where people move fast, and take real responsibility

 ***Equal Opportunity Employer***

*We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Platform Program Manager, AMP Partner Operations
jobs.description:
Apple’s Partner Operations team is seeking an experienced, highly collaborative, and technically astute Program Manager to lead platform capability expansion across our Apple services partnerships.  

  

**Description**  

  

In this role, you will bridge business strategy, technical integration, and partner execution. You will guide global partners\-spanning telecommunications carriers, subscription video on demand (SVOD) providers, and retail integrators\-through the onboarding lifecycle, ensuring they can seamlessly adopt new platform capabilities. You will operate comfortably in the gray, translate complex commerce and linking architectures into actionable operational workflows, and drive alignment across Business Development, Engineering, Product, QA, Marketing, Legal, and more. You will also continue to refine parter onboarding and management processes and tools, utilizing innovative approaches \- knowing when to use technical tools such as AI while understanding the necessity for face to face collaboration. ","responsibilities":"You will own the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle for new platform features and major partner launches. Your core responsibilities include:  

  

Platform Capability \& Feature Onboarding  

  

Drive Partner Adoption of Platform Capabilities: Lead the operational rollout and partner adoption for emerging features to our billing platform.  

  

Partner with product and engineering teams to establish operational readiness for novel subscription bundling models (e.g., streaming and carrier bundles), tier upgrades/downgrades via update\-entitlement APIs, and multi\-country configurations.  

  

Define Migration \& Sunset Flows (CIP to Direct): Own the Partner Ops workstream for transitioning subscribers between partner\-billed and Apple\-direct models, defining end\-to\-end operational requirements, PVT validation flows, and subscription cancellation/revocation procedures.  

  

Technical Operations  

  

Lead Production Verification \& Testing Strategy: Partner with Commerce QA and Central Marketing UAT to define and execute comprehensive PVT plans; coordinate partner dependencies, including test SIM sourcing, test accounts, and allowlisting.  

  

Investigate Discrepancies \& Resolve Blockers: Triage operational and technical blockers impacting partner launches (e.g., deep\-link localization/offer sheet display issues, tax ID formatting on partner invoicing, missing commerce signals, and account unlinking edge cases).  

  

Operational Infrastructure \& Scalability  

  

Oversee intake trackers from the partner ops team and roadmap requests for platform enhancements; prioritize requests with engineering and product teams to balance partner velocity with long\-term platform health.  

  

Standardize Governance \& Enablement: Partner with regional teams (AMR, EMEIA, APAC) and integrators to deliver consistent integration best practices, partner capability trackers, and onboarding toolkits.  

  

Drive Process Automation: Identify manual intervention points across the onboarding lifecycle and work cross\-functionally to transition them into automated, self\-serve, and scalable tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

BA/BS degree required; technical, engineering, or business operations background preferred.  

  

8\+ years of relevant industry experience in technical program management, partner operations, or systems integration.  

  

Experience in telecommunications carrier billing, digital streaming services (OTT/SVOD), or digital commerce platforms is strongly preferred.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

8\+ years of technical program or operations management experience driving complex, partner\-facing integrations, digital customer journeys, and back\-end platform capabilities.  

  

Deep familiarity with subscription lifecycle mechanics, recurring billing, and API\-driven partner integrations  

  

Proven track record in end\-to\-end partner onboarding \& operational readiness, from defining intake processes and writing operational requirements to coordinating production verification testing (PVT/UAT).  

  

Strong cross\-functional orchestration skills, with the demonstrated ability to lead workstreams across Engineering, Product, Business Development, Commerce/Billing, Legal/Privacy, and Regional Operations teams globally.  

  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving aptitude, with experience troubleshooting back\-end event triggers, signaling mechanisms, and data\-flow discrepancies across multi\-party ecosystems.  

  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting technical concepts clearly to executive leadership, authoring partner\-facing integration guides, and managing multi\-stakeholder operational reviews.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $149,200 and $249,000, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Job summary  

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer\-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data\-driven decisions and analytical problem\-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.  

  

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile \- where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile \- where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile \- when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.  

  

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:  

* Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
* Lead large\-scope projects with site and regional impact
* Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* Experience managing a team of 2\+ salaried employees and 70\+ indirect employees
* Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
* Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
* Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
* Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

jobs.title: Event Project Manager — Signage & Experiential
jobs.description:
VIVAS is a San Francisco signage company. We design, print, fabricate and install signage and large\-format graphics for offices, buildings, retail spaces and events across the Bay Area. Our shop is in the Bayview and our crews work all over the Bay Area.

Half of our work is events and experiential: booths, SEG fabric backdrops, environmental graphics and full venue branding for conferences, activations and large\-scale productions. We're hiring a second Event Project Manager to run events end to end alongside our current PM. In events the date cannot move. Your job is to make sure that on the morning of the event, everything is printed, loaded, delivered and installed — and that nothing about it was a surprise.

**What you'll do**

* Run the project from kickoff to closeout, working backwards from the event date
* Coordinate with venues: load\-in windows, dock access, badges, permits, certificates of insurance
* Keep every job documented and current in Monday, our project system
* Chase artwork through to client approval before it reaches production
* Be on site for install and strike — this is not a desk\-only role
* Close the project out: final walkthrough, photos, and a clean handoff back to the account owner
* Flag a problem the day you see it, not the week of the event

**What we're looking for**

* 2\+ years coordinating events, trade shows, productions, or projects with a hard deadline
* Someone organized enough to hold twenty moving pieces without a single one going quiet
* Comfortable talking to venue operations staff, vendors and clients
* Calm on site when something doesn't match the plan — because it will
* Available for early mornings, evenings and occasional weekends when that's the only install window a venue gives us
* English and Spanish is a strong plus — our shop and crew work in both
* Valid driver's license
* Experience with signage, print or fabrication is a plus, not a requirement — we'll teach you the materials

**What we offer**

* $30\.00 – $35\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Full time, hourly and overtime eligible — we pay for the hours the job actually takes
* Paid sick leave under San Francisco law
* A clear path: this role grows into owning the delivered margin of your projects, not just the delivery

Established by Chief Curator and Executive Director Cheryl Haines in 2003, FOR\-SITE is dedicated to the creation, understanding, and presentation of art about place. Through exhibitions, commissions, and educational programs, FOR\-SITE supports the creation and presentation of art that inspires fresh thinking and dialogue about our natural and cultural environment. www.for\-site.org

**Position Summary** 

The Exhibition Project Manager plays a key integrative role in the organization, ensuring the smooth and efficient planning and delivery of FOR\-SITE’s exhibitions. Reporting to the Chief Curator and Executive Director (CCED) and collaborating closely with FOR\-SITE staff and contractors, this position combines exhibition research and project management with organizational and administrative support—helping to guide large\-scale, site\-specific exhibitions from early\-stage development through production, installation, and maintenance.

This is an in\-person, full\-time position at FOR\-SITE’s San Francisco office, located at Fort Mason Center for Arts \& Culture.

The ideal candidate will be highly organized, resourceful, and collaborative, with strong project\-management experience in a nonprofit arts setting.

**Key Responsibilities and Duties**

* At the direction of the CCED, **conduct and compile research** on artists, artworks, and sites for current and future exhibitions.
* Communicate effectively with artists, project partners, vendors, contractors, and fabricators to **manage the preparation of exhibition sites and the production and transportation of artworks.**
* **Manage artwork installation, maintenance, and de\-installation**; supervise installation crews, and oversee on\-site logistics.
* Draft, execute, and manage **artist contracts and loan agreements**.
* **Track project budgets, expenses, and invoices**
* **Provide project and administrative support to the CCED**, including correspondence, scheduling, research, and strategic planning, acting as a point of contact as needed.
* **Prepare briefing materials, presentations, and other documentation** to support FOR\-SITE's exhibition program.
* **Coordinate meetings, travel, and communications** with internal and external stakeholders, including FOR\-SITE board meetings.
* Work with the CCED to **secure necessary permits**; liaise with exhibition partners to facilitate project compliance and review processes.
* **Coordinate the work of volunteers, interns, and vendors**.
* Represent FOR\-SITE at art community and outreach events.

**Desired Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of experience planning and managing the logistics and installation of art exhibitions.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail; a creative thinker with strong problem\-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with Mac OS, Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, Dropbox, database management, and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Excellent verbal, written, and listening communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Knowledge of contemporary art, artists, and institutions is a significant plus.
* Bachelor's degree in nonprofit administration, arts administration, museum studies, public art, or art history.

FOR\-SITE strives to attract a diverse group of candidates for employment. We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and are dedicated to fair and inclusive employment practices.

Full\-time, exempt position
