jobs.description:
**About Pacific Tech Communication**

Pacific Tech Communication (PTC) is a growing national telecommunications infrastructure contractor delivering OSP fiber construction, splicing, and related services for Tier 1 and Tier 2 providers. We are hiring a Fiber Splicing Project Manager to own splicing operations from crew assignment through close\-out, billing, and customer delivery.

**Position Summary**

The Fiber Splicing Project Manager plans, schedules, and leads fiber splicing crews and subcontractors across active markets. This is a working leadership role responsible for production, quality, safety, training, customer communication, and accurate billing. Significant travel to job sites and customer markets is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Crew Scheduling \& Resource Management**

* Build and maintain daily, weekly, and look\-ahead crew schedules for in\-house splicers and subcontractors.
* Assign work by skill level, equipment, location, and customer priority; balance multiple concurrent projects.
* Coordinate mobilization, lodging, vehicles, trailers, fusion splicers, OTDRs, and materials so crews arrive ready to produce.
* Adjust schedules for weather, customer change orders, restoration work, and night/weekend cutovers.
* Track headcount, production units, and capacity; flag resource gaps early.

**Training \& Crew Development**

* Onboard new splicers and leads; verify competency on fusion splicing, ribbon fiber, enclosures, testing, and documentation.
* Deliver and document field training on company methods, customer specs, and quality standards.
* Mentor junior splicers; evaluate performance and recommend promotions, coaching, or corrective action.
* Maintain training records and support certification paths (FOA/ETA or equivalent preferred).

**Safety \& Compliance**

* Enforce OSHA, NESC, DOT, and company safety requirements on every job.
* Ensure daily tailgates/JSAs, PPE, traffic control, and confined space/aerial practices are completed and documented.
* Conduct field safety observations and stop work when conditions are unsafe.
* Support incident reporting, near\-miss capture, and corrective actions.

**Billing, Production Tracking \& Close\-Out**

* Capture daily production (splices, enclosures, footage, testing, restoration) against contract units or T\&M.
* Review timesheets, per diem, material tickets, and subcontractor invoices for accuracy before submission.
* Prepare and submit billing packages, as\-builts, OTDR/OLTS results, and customer close\-out documentation on time.
* Resolve billing discrepancies with operations, accounting, and the customer.
* Protect project margin by controlling overtime, rework, idle time, and material waste.

**Customer Relationship \& Communication**

* Serve as the primary field contact for customer construction managers, inspectors, and NOC/restoration teams.
* Provide clear daily/weekly progress updates, forecasts, and issue escalation.
* Walk jobs with the customer; resolve punch\-list and quality items quickly.
* Protect customer relationships during outages, cutovers, and schedule conflicts.
* Coordinate with internal project managers, construction leads, and engineering on prints, splice matrices, and cut sheets.

**Travel \& Field Presence**

* Travel regularly across assigned markets and projects (expected 80%\+ depending on workload), including overnight and multi\-week assignments.
* Be present on critical splices, large cutovers, restorations, and customer ride\-outs.
* Support night work, weekends, and on\-call restoration as project and customer needs require.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to operate or travel with company vehicles required.

**Qualifications**

* 8\+ years hands\-on fiber optic splicing experience (OSP aerial, underground, and/or FTTH).
* 5\+ years supervising splicers, leads, or subcontract splicing crews.
* Proven ability to read splice diagrams, construction prints, and fiber assignment records.
* Working knowledge of fusion splicers, OTDR, power meter/OLTS, and acceptance testing standards.
* Experience with production tracking, unit billing or T\&M billing, and close\-out packages.
* Strong safety record and familiarity with OSHA field requirements.
* Clear written and verbal communication with crews and customers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook) and willingness to use company scheduling/field apps.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; FOA CFOT/CFOS or equivalent a plus.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively; valid U.S. driver’s license; acceptable MVR.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting Tier 1/2 providers (Lumen, AT\&T, Charter, or similar).
* Prior work in multi\-state contractor environments.
* OSHA 10/30, First Aid/CPR.
* Bilingual English/Spanish/Russian a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.
* Opportunity to build and lead splicing operations on national carrier work.
* Direct visibility with operations leadership.
* Benefits details provided during the interview process.

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

* Driver License (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: Remote

Merchant Boarding \& Business Services – POS

POS Manager, Professional Services

Payroc is a global payments technology company helping businesses get paid, grow faster, and operate smarter. From powerful POS systems to seamless online and mobile payment solutions, we equip merchants with the tools they need to succeed in today’s fast\-moving commerce landscape.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and collaborative approach
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with strong attention to detail
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Monday.com, Jira, or similar project tracking software
* PMP, Scrum, or Agile certifications are a plus
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Project Management, or a related field preferred
**Working Conditions*** Combination of office\-based, remote, and customer\-site work, depending on implementation schedules and business needs.

### **Position:** ***Program Manager, Specialty Programs***



Monogram Health is seeking a **Program Manager, Specialty Programs** to serve as the day\-to\-day operational lead of one or more of Monogram's specialty care programs. This is a high\-ownership individual contributor role that may be asked to flex across Monogram's specialty portfolio as organizational needs evolve. The right candidate thrives in ambiguity, can hold multiple operational threads simultaneously, takes pride in building durable systems, and brings the urgency and follow\-through to keep complex programs running for a seamless patient and clinician experience.



This is a high\-ownership individual contributor role that may be asked to flex across Monogram's specialty portfolio as organizational needs evolve. jobs.description:
Ben Allegretti Consulting, Inc. (BAC) is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business. Our team of remote professionals has supported federal health programs since 2007, with a focus on human factors engineering, health informatics, and process improvement. We are building a FOIA team to support a federal health agency and are looking for career FOIA practitioners who want their judgment to carry weight.

**Position Summary**

Our FOIA PM leads one major FOIA task grouping, such as routine cases and appeals, litigation, or other agency components, and serves as the primary contact for the government's Contracting Officer's Representative. You will manage the schedule, reporting, quality control, and staff performance for a team of FOIA analysts, and you will stay close enough to the casework to make sound disclosure decisions when they matter.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead a team of FOIA analysts who process routine, backlogged, appeal, and litigation cases from intake through closure.
* Act as the day\-to\-day contact for the Contracting Officer's Representative and agency FOIA leadership, and run bi\-weekly status meetings with agendas and minutes.
* Deliver weekly and monthly progress reports covering cases closed, backlog remaining, risks, and recommendations.
* Manage progress against backlog reduction goals, including closure of the oldest requests and appeals.
* Oversee quality control by reviewing disclosure determinations, exemption rationales, and redactions before work goes to the government.
* Maintain the project management plan, risk register, and staffing plan, and track onboarding, system access, training, and background investigation requirements for the team.
* Identify process and systems improvements and prepare briefings, white papers, and option papers for agency leadership.
* Coordinate with agency components, regional offices, and requesters as directed by the Contracting Officer's Representative.

**What You Bring**

* Masters degree and 8 years directing teams or equivalent experience.
* 10 or more years of federal FOIA experience, including at least 5 years leading or supervising FOIA staff or a FOIA program.
* Working knowledge of the Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. 552\), the Privacy Act, HIPAA, and the foreseeable harm standard.
* Experience with FOIA case management systems such as FOIAXpress and with eDiscovery platforms such as Relativity.
* Strong written communication, including reports, correspondence, and leadership briefings.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust background investigation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP or comparable project management credential.
* Experience at HHS, CMS, VA or another federal health agency.
* Experience supporting FOIA litigation and appeals.
* Track record of reducing a FOIA backlog.
* Process improvement training such as Lean Six Sigma.

**Work Environment and Requirements**

This is a remote position. Work is performed through the agency's virtual desktop environment using government\-provided systems and tools. The role requires the ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation (Public Trust) and to complete required security, privacy, and records management training before starting work. US Citizenship required. This position is contingent upon contract award.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The pay range for this position is $125,000 to $140,000 per year. Placement in the range depends on experience and demonstrated FOIA depth.

**Medical, dental, vision, holidays, PTO, sick leave, profit sharing etc.**

 **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

**Position Location:** Remote — work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with occasional travel to job sites, lab environments, and company meetings

 **JOB SUMMARY**


Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance. Our Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project — and it is the home of SmartTech.ai, our company\-wide AI enablement program.

  

AI adoption at STC has grown fast and organically: capable people across every department have built real tools and returned real time. That grassroots energy is our foundation — and it has outgrown an informal, team\-by\-team approach. As AI Program Manager, you will take SmartTech.ai from siloed experimentation to a governed, supported, and scalable capability — setting light\-touch policy and standards, standing up the development frameworks and hosting platforms that turn prototypes into deployable products, pairing the right tools to the right use cases, and raising the AI fluency of every employee through training, messaging, and hands\-on support.

  

This is STC's first dedicated AI enablement hire. You will report to the VP of Engineering \& Technology, operate within the SPI department, and coordinate a hub\-and\-spoke network of departmental AI Champions. You are equal parts builder and enabler — technical enough to architect and ship AI solutions yourself, and skilled enough with people and process to make the entire company better at using AI. You will receive general direction on objectives and work independently to build the program, communicating and operating in line with organizational goals and values as well as departmental objectives.

 **Program Governance, Policy \& Intake (20%)**

* Establish light\-touch, practical governance for AI use company\-wide — acceptable\-use standards, data\-handling and security guardrails, and a clear tool\-approval pathway — in partnership with IT and InfoSec
* Contribute to development of the innovation and idea intake (“funnel”), triaging incoming requests and prototypes and prioritizing them by value, effort, and risk
* Maintain a lightweight review cadence that keeps the program safe and consistent without slowing the people doing the work

 **AI Enablement, Training \& Messaging (20%)**

* Raise the AI fluency of the entire company — technical and non\-technical staff alike — through hands\-on training, office hours, documentation, and reusable prompt and workflow libraries
* Own internal messaging and change management for SmartTech.ai: announcements, wins, and adoption campaigns that build momentum and engagement
* Coordinate the departmental AI Champions network, turning individual wins into shared, company\-wide capability

 **Solution Development \& Deployment (20%)**

* Turn ideas and prototypes into deployable, supportable solutions — designing, building, and shipping LLM\-powered tools, agents, and integrations
* Serve as a hands\-on power user of Claude and modern AI development tools, setting the technical bar for prompt engineering, agentic workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) over company knowledge, and API integration
* Harden and deploy high\-value prototypes built by others so delivery teams can rely on them without owning their maintenance

 **Development Frameworks \& Hosting Platforms (15%)**

* Design and stand up the sanctioned development environments, hosting platforms, and DevOps toolchain (source control, CI/CD, containerization, cloud hosting) that let AI solutions be built, deployed, and maintained safely and repeatably
* Replace ad\-hoc, unsanctioned workarounds with secure, documented, scalable infrastructure, in coordination with IT and InfoSec
* Establish reusable patterns, templates, and reference architectures for AI application development

 **Tool \& Use\-Case Portfolio Management (15%)**

* Evaluate, select, and manage the company's portfolio of AI tools and platforms; map tools to specific business needs and use cases so teams adopt the right tool for the job
* Track adoption, value, and ROI; maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI investments aligned to corporate growth targets
* Manage vendor relationships, licensing, and cost, and advise leadership on build\-vs\-buy decisions

 **Technology, Digital Tools \& AI\-Enabled Efficiency (10%)**

* Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance
* Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


We are hiring a Quality Assurance Manager to support the QA function within Devoted’s Risk Adjustment organization. This person owns the quality assurance program for our retrospective coding and auditing operations: the policies and SOPs behind it, the team that runs it, and the findings it produces. You will direct the work of a team of QA Reviewers, own the QA relationship with internal operational leaders and vendor partners (including AHS off\-shore coding teams), review escalated charts yourself or facilitate further escalation, and turn findings into education and process changes that raise coding accuracy across the department. You will also inform how technology is used to assist this work in accordance with our acceptable use policy.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

* Serve as an expert on ICD\-10\-CM coding guidelines, AHA Coding Clinic guidance, and internal risk adjustment guidance
* Oversee an offshore FDR vendor team of QA Reviewers: set accuracy and productivity standards, review performance against them, and adjust volume allocation based on results
* Escalate staffing, training, and quality gaps to vendor management, which owns hiring, onboarding, and day\-to\-day supervision
* Own and maintain Devoted’s QA policies and SOPs for coding quality, retrospective coding, and audit operations (operational and subject matter owner; subject matter owner for the others)
* Plan QA review coverage and sampling across internal staff and vendors, including AHS off\-shore coding teams, so that samples are representative and review volumes are met
* Perform QA reviews of escalated, disputed, and high\-risk charts, and serving as the internal authority on coding disagreements the team cannot resolve; ensuring diagnoses selected for review are appropriate, accurate, and supported by clinical documentation
* Own the monthly and quarterly QA Scorecard process: accuracy of the findings, delivery to Risk Adjustment leadership, coders, and vendor leaders during meetings, and follow\-through on remediation plans
* Identify documentation and coding trends across reviewers and vendors, present them to department leadership, and convert them into education, job aids, or process changes
* Run the review of individual QA work so the QA team’s own accuracy is measured, and incorporating material findings into the QA process going forward
* Partner with vendor leadership on quality expectations, corrective action, and escalation when performance does not meet standard
* Own timely resolution of coding questions from sources coding on behalf of Devoted, and maintaining the log of questions and answers as outlined by policy or procedure
* Partner with technology and analytics teams on risk adjustment tooling, including AI\-assisted coding: define QA requirements, test releases and enhancements, and provide feedback on design and performance, within acceptable use policies
* Build and run monitoring for tools in production, tracking performance drift and error patterns concentrated in specific conditions, chart types, providers, or member populations
* Support retrospective coding and audits by abstracting medical records or ICD\-10 codes for submission to CMS when volume or complexity requires it
* Recommend process improvements and preparing department reporting so productivity and quality goals are met or exceeded and operational efficiency is optimized
* Serving as a voting risk adjustment coding SME member on Devoted’s Coding Steering Workgroup
* Act in an ethical manner as required under HIPAA’s Privacy and Security rules, handling patient data with uncompromised adherence to the law, including what member data may be sent to which vendor systems
* Perform other related duties as required

***Required skills and experience:***

* Current relevant coding certification recognized by AAPC or AHIMA. Examples of relevant certifications include: CPC, CRC, CCS, CCS\-P
* 7\+ years of recent and related experience in medical record documentation review, diagnosis coding, and/or auditing, including risk adjustment coding
* Experience leading development and presentation of accuracy or performance results to production coders or management
* Sound knowledge of ICD\-10\-CM coding guidelines and regulations to meet regulatory, compliance, and internal policy requirements, and the ability to read medical records and abstract clinical diagnosis codes from documentation

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Expertise in CMS risk adjustment models
* Experience managing or overseeing vendor and/or off\-shore coding teams
* Experience validating or auditing AI\-assisted, NLP, or computer\-assisted coding (CAC) tools, or other automated chart review technology
* Experience writing or substantially revising QA policies, SOPs, or audit sampling methodology
* Communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, including formatting and presenting QA Review results and delivering findings to staff and vendor leaders

jobs.description:
**Why Mozilla?**

Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open\-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**About this team and role:**

Mozilla’s Customer Experience team helps users, organizations, and partners successfully adopt, use, and get sustained value from Mozilla products. As Mozilla expands its business and organizational offerings, we are building a support operation designed for the needs of B2B customers, including dependable service delivery, clear customer commitments, global coverage, and close coordination with Product and Engineering.



As Staff Enterprise Support Operations Manager, you will be Mozilla’s first dedicated B2B support operations leader. You will not inherit a mature operation; you will build one. You will participate in a defined incident coverage model and periodically lead the operational response to major customer incidents. In those moments, you will ensure vendors follow established procedures, coordinate escalation and handoffs to Mozilla engineers, drive cross\-functional resolution, communicate clearly with customers and internal leaders, and oversee post\-incident reviews and root cause analysis.



This position requires a rare combination of support operations expertise, vendor management, program development, technical fluency, and calm leadership under pressure. jobs.description:
Condor Health is seeking an experienced independent professional to serve as a Technical Account Manager (TAM) supporting customers using our SaaS solutions. This role combines customer success, technical account management, analytical problem\-solving, project coordination, product demonstration, and consultative account growth.

**Overview**

The Technical Account Manager serves as the primary relationship and operational point of contact for an assigned portfolio of customers. The TAM is responsible for understanding each customer's use of our solutions, proactively managing service needs, coordinating customer requests and issues, and helping customers successfully use their contracted products and services.

Our customers represent a range of roles and technical backgrounds. The TAM therefore serves as an important bridge between customers and our Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, Project, and Support teams. The TAM must be able to understand product functionality and technical concepts well enough to translate them into clear, practical language for customers, while also accurately communicating customer workflows, needs, and concerns to internal teams.

*The TAM needs enough product and software\-development literacy to recognize what kind of work is needed, get the right people involved, and help shepherd that work through the customer relationship.*

The TAM is not expected to function as a software engineer or Business Analyst. For change orders and other development work, the TAM partners with Business Analysts and technical resources who lead detailed discovery, requirements, and solution definition. The TAM remains the customer\-facing owner and provides project\-management\-style coordination during execution, helping maintain communication, track decisions and actions, surface risks or blockers, and support timely completion.

The role also includes a consultative account\-growth component. TAMs are expected to understand customer needs, identify opportunities where additional products or services may provide value, demonstrate relevant capabilities, and support appropriate account expansion. This is not a quota\- or commission\-based sales role.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the ongoing relationship and routine account\-management activities for assigned customers within defined decision authority, escalating technical, project, contractual, commercial, or relationship matters as appropriate.
* Proactively manage customer service needs and account priorities to support customer satisfaction, retention, adoption, and successful use of contracted solutions.
* Prepare for and facilitate recurring customer account\-management meetings; develop agendas, review open items, guide discussion, document decisions and action items, and ensure timely follow\-through.
* Investigate and triage customer questions and requests, identify missing information, determine appropriate next steps, and engage the correct internal resources rather than simply routing questions between teams.
* Serve as a translator between predominantly nontechnical customers and internal Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, Project, and Support teams.
* Communicate technical and product information in clear, practical language appropriate for nontechnical audiences while distinguishing confirmed information from matters requiring further validation.
* Provide targeted product and feature demonstrations to explain functionality, address customer questions, support adoption, and help customers evaluate potential solutions to identified needs.
* Monitor customer support tickets, change requests, change orders, and other account\-level activities; coordinate communications and help ensure contracted service\-level expectations are met.

* Represent the voice of the customer in appropriate internal discussions while balancing customer needs with contracted scope, product capabilities, organizational priorities, and confirmed commitments.
* Develop a strong understanding of customer needs and identify opportunities where additional products or services may provide value; demonstrate relevant solutions and support consultative account\-expansion discussions.
* Recognize when a customer request may represent additional scope, a change order, a training need, a support issue, a configuration question, or a product opportunity, and engage the appropriate process and resources.
* Collaborate with internal teams on customer\-facing training resources, release communications, webinars, and other enablement activities as appropriate.
* Act as a liaison among customers, internal teams, and vendors when coordination is required.
* Identify and document opportunities to improve account\-management and customer\-facing processes when within contracted scope.
* Perform services in accordance with agreed project procedures and applicable security and confidentiality requirements.

**What Success in This Role Requires**

* Technical aptitude and learning agility: Ability to learn complex SaaS products, workflows, terminology, and software\-development concepts; deep technical expertise at hire is not required.

* Technical translation: Ability to understand information from technical teams and explain it accurately to nontechnical customers, and to translate customer needs into useful context for internal teams.

jobs.description:
At Duetto, you'll own the full post\-sales journey for a portfolio of strategic hotel, resort, and casino accounts — from onboarding through renewal — acting as a trusted advisor who helps clients turn data into real revenue growth.


**What Makes Us Different?**  

Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue \& Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the \#1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the \#1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025\. * Lead resolution of tough business and product challenges, serving as the go\-to person when strategic accounts need help fast
* Run strategic business reviews and advanced training sessions, using AI\-assisted tools to show clients clear, documented ROI
* Dig into usage data and market performance metrics with AI\-assisted analytics to spot churn risk early and uncover upsell opportunities
* Partner with Product, Sales, and Support to champion what your clients need, and mentor junior CSMs along the way


**What We're Looking For**


*You may be a good fit if you have the following:*


* 6\+ years in a customer\-facing role in SaaS, hospitality tech, or revenue management, including experience with complex, multi\-stakeholder accounts
* 3\+ years in hospitality revenue management, with strong command of KPIs like RevPAR, ADR, RGI, ARI, and MPI, plus familiarity with profitability metrics like GOP and GOPPAR
* A track record of resolving thorny client issues independently and shaping account\-level revenue strategy
* Comfort with Salesforce and reporting platforms like Tableau
* Genuine enthusiasm for working with AI\-assisted tools and evolving how you work as new tooling comes online
* Fluent English, and authorized to work in the US without employer sponsorship
* Ability to travel regionally across North America (25–40%)


*Strong candidates may also have:*


* Specialized hospitality tech experience, particularly in revenue management
* Hands\-on experience with Revenue Management Systems and RMS optimization consulting
* A good read on North America hospitality market dynamics and distribution

**Why Duetto?**


* You'll work at the frontier of hospitality and AI — Duetto is redesigning how every role operates with AI, and this one's no exception. You'll be equipped and encouraged to use AI\-assisted tools daily, not just talk about them.

* Work model: Fully remote

This position is responsible for managed care, insurance verification and patient price estimate processes within the Centralized Managed Care \& Price Estimates (CMC) department. * Appropriately code insurance plans within EPIC system for billing purposes.

* For self\-pay patients, complete duties associated with financial assistance determinations such as above/below the line. Including connecting patients with necessary social work or financial counseling to assist in the coverage process.
* Complete necessary forms prior to upcoming procedures, admissions, and/or appointments (i.e. Non\-Covered Charges Form (NCCF), Advanced Beneficiary Notification (ABN) or Patient Financial Estimate (FE)) as required.

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**About Genius Academy**

Genius Academy is an AI\-powered education company helping students build real\-world professional skills through immersive simulations. Our experiences place learners in realistic scenarios where they develop the confidence and judgment needed to navigate complex human situations.

We partner with colleges and universities across the country to bring these experiences into academic programs, preparing the next generation of professionals in counseling, social work, psychology, and nursing.

**What we are looking for**

* Highly organized individual, with a track record of running multiple projects at once and staying on top of the details.
* Comfortable working across project tracking tools such as Asana, Airtable, and Notion, and quick to learn new ones.
* Strong written communication. Much of this role is clear, concise writing to colleagues and external partners.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of everyday work.
* Experience coordinating across teams, functions, or external partners.
* \[Nice to have] Experience with vendor management, business compliance, or expense administration.

**Where and when**

* This is a fully remote role, open to candidates in any location.
* Core hours overlap with US business hours and the role requires regular attendance at meetings scheduled in US time zones.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a short note about why this role interests you to .

**About the role**

The Operations Associate supports the day\-to\-day running of Genius Academy across operations, production coordination, and content support. The role works with people across the company and reports to the VP of Operations \& People.

**Working principle**

Work in this role is operational in nature. Colleagues across the company can bring work directly to this role, and the test for whether something belongs here is whether it is operational and aligns with the responsibilities below. Work that falls outside that is agreed with the VP of Operations \& People before it is taken on.

**Operations**

* Support company\-wide and group meetings: schedule meetings, gather agenda items and updates from attendees, build the slides, share the slides during the meeting, take notes, and send a follow\-up summary afterwards with links to everything discussed.
* Track assigned projects and initiatives across the company, keeping status, owners, and next steps current.
* Maintain documentation and file organization across operational records, including:
* Vendors
* Insurance
* State \& Federal Registrations
* Expense Tracking \& Categorization

**Production coordination**

* Set up and maintain production tracking for new and active projects, including cast and crew tables covering names, required dates, scripts involved, and confirmation status.
* Attend the production meetings on behalf of the VP of Operations \& People, share the tracking page so the team can review status together, and report progress, risks, and issues back.
* Coordinate scheduling and communications for live sessions with actors, instructors, and partner institutions.
* Organize content production data.

**Content support**

* Prepare first\-draft supporting documentation for new content and load it into Airtable for review and finalization.
* Update and correct content as needed, including summaries and scripts.
* Review finished content for consistency and quality before it moves to the next stage.
* Participate in Non\-Development QA passes as assigned by Product.
* Receive deliverables from project partners and ensure distribution to the correct individuals.

**Support across the team**

* Support colleagues across the company on operational and production work, including turning requests and correspondence into tracked tasks.
* Track the status of work across active projects, and flag delays, scheduling conflicts, capacity issues, and approaching deadlines to the people affected and to the VP of Operations \& People.

**How this role works**

* Reports to the VP of Operations \& People, who sets priorities.
* Colleagues bring work to this role directly. Work is recorded in a shared tracker so that priorities stay visible.

**What success looks like**

* Operational records are current and can be relied on without checking.
* Production status is visible to the team, and conflicts are raised before they become urgent.
* Content support work is completed to schedule and hands off cleanly to the next stage.
* Work is visible in the tracker, so priorities can be adjusted before capacity becomes a problem.

Pay: $49,229\.23 \- $59,286\.81 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

jobs.title: Research Operations Specialist - Contracts, Vendors & Spend
jobs.description:
**About the Role**


We're looking for an experienced Research Operations Specialist to own the contracts, vendor relationships, and spending behind a research team of roughly sixty researchers and a portfolio of about fifty active research agencies and research tool vendors. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you'll:


* guide contracts from project request through signed agreement,
* serve as the team's go\-to partner for Finance on budgets and forecasts,
* give researchers clear visibility into where their projects stand.

You'll join a small research operations team with real room to streamline how work gets done, including through the use of AI tools.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Execute contracts end to end: once a researcher raises a project, guide it through scoping, statement of work, approvals, and kickoff.
* Represent researchers in scoping and negotiation. Translate study needs into clear commercial terms and make confident calls that limit unnecessary back\-and\-forth.
* Partner closely with Finance and research leads on budgeting and forecasting so leads know how they're tracking against budget throughout the year. This includes spend tracking, quarterly forecasts, and monthly budget reviews.
* Maintain a clear, current view of all active contracts, onboarding, and approvals, and proactively keep researchers informed on status and next steps.
* Manage spend requests from intake through approval in Zip and Oracle, including purchase orders, change orders, invoices, and requisitions.
* Onboard and offboard vendors and tools from start to finish. This covers supplier questionnaires, NDAs, risk and privacy reviews, legal routing, and tool access and integrations.
* Coordinate master service agreements, statements of work, NDAs, and renewals with Legal and Procurement. Adapt to the differing legal, procurement, and data requirements of international markets, including EMEA and China.
* Maintain the contract repository, retainer trackers, and master supplier list.
* Track renewals at 30, 60, and 90 days, and support the transition of vendors and agencies to retainer\-based models.
* Support vendor evaluation and consolidation, including reviewing data\-use, model\-training, and data processing terms for AI tools.
* Serve as the team's primary point of contact with Legal, Privacy, Security, Procurement, Sourcing, Finance, and Accounts Payable.
* Anticipate and resolve review bottlenecks, set clear timeline expectations with researchers, and escalate early when reviews stall.
* Maintain the team's operating data in Airtable and support knowledge management across the shared drive, research repository, and team tools.

**Qualifications**


*Required*


* 7\+ years of experience in procurement, contract administration, or vendor operations; 10\+ years is ideal.
* Strong contract\-reading judgment. You can understand terms, spot gaps or risks early, and know when to involve Legal.
* Experience with contracting and procurement across global markets, including how legal, privacy, and procurement requirements differ by region.
* Hands\-on experience with procure\-to\-pay systems, ideally Zip and Oracle. Candidates with strong experience on comparable platforms, such as Coupa, who learn new systems quickly will be considered.
* A systems\-minded approach: you see the full lifecycle from intake to contract to spend, get ahead of problems, and find ways to work more efficiently.
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with clear, proactive communication with researchers, finance partners, and vendors.

*Preferred*


* A legal or contracts\-focused background, such as paralegal or contract management experience.
* Experience working in or alongside research teams, particularly UX research, market research, or consumer insights.
* Hands\-on Airtable experience, including automations.
* Experience with Salesforce and DocuSign.
* Day\-to\-day use of AI tools, ideally including building automations, agents, or AI\-assisted workflows.

**Key Details**


* Start Date: October 19, 2026
* Duration: Estimated through December 31, 2027
* Location: Remote (within the U.S.)
* Work Schedule: Part\-time, 30 hours per week (6 hours per day, Monday\-Friday), with occasional flexibility needed to support international partners
* Pay Rate: $100\-$114 per hour \+ benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k)
* Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* Engagement: W2 Contract role through Maleda Tech.

new_jobs.title: Community Health Worker III
new_jobs.description:
**Overall Summary:**


The Community Health Worker III (CHW III) at Bay Area Community Health will primarily work at serving and assisting our patients while located at different sites throughout the organization and community in both Alameda and Santa Clara Counties. CHW III will work at different capacities based on their assigned area of training and specialty. The CHW III will be a trusted member of the community, and actively participate as a liaison between primary care, specialties and resources available to BACH patients. Activities may include, but are not limited to, outreach, engagement, care coordination, case management, linkage of the patient with resources at BACH and in the community such as food, housing, financial and transportation assistance and linking the patient to brick and mortar sites.


**Essential Responsibilities:**


The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks and responsibilities. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.* Under the general direction of the supervisor/manager, the Community Health Worker performs a variety of services. Duties include:

* CHW, I and II tasks, plus:
* Coordinate and deliver training for CHW I through CHW II
* Schedule staff for other external or online training
* Prepare and deliver presentations
* Assess patient’s home living situation
* Conduct housing and crisis assessments in various portals, as applicable
* Conduct SDOH assessments and provide resources as appropriate
* Conduct intake assessment of clients referred for case management
* Monitor, document, and report staff productivity through internal and external reports
* Assist in monitoring of patient referrals
* Utilize PDSA model for continuous process improvement
* Develop and nurture collaborative relationships with community partners
* Ensure compliance with health plan, county grant, or specific program requirements
* Support patient engagement, linkage, coordination, monitoring, follow\-up and advocacy
* Promote integrated care among primary care providers and specialties
* Perform general administration duties
* Adhere to all HIPAA rules and regulations
* Adhere to the policy and procedures of BACH
* Conduct file reviews to maintain compliance of program.
* Assist with providing training and development to support staff in meeting their expectations.
* Respond to requests for information, researches, resolves complex problems, and prepares correspondence of a sensitive and/or confidential nature.
* Ensure program participant compliance with all applicable rules, regulations, standards, and policies and procedures.
* Develop and periodically update an inventory of available resources for patients.
* Establish a pool of partners and networks that would facilitate access to resources and programs for eligible patients.
* Work flexible hours, which includes some evenings and weekends
* Work at any of BACH location, including clinics, mobiles, schools, homeless encampments, warming centers and patients’ homes, or patient appointments as assigned

**Secondary Responsibilities:**

* Attends workshops, training, and meetings as needed, and as requested
* Assists with mentoring, training, information and providing guidance to team members.
* Assists with the review, interpretation, determination of impact, and implementation of program regulation and services, and recommends improvements.
* Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor

**Qualifications:**




**Required Education, Experience, and Training:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* 2\-4 years of experience in a community\-based health care service capacity preferred
* AS/AA in health or related field preferred
* Bilingual preferred
* CEC Certification, if applicable
* CHW Certification \- Recertification and/or retraining process, as required

**Work Conditions:**

* Travel to other sites and/or locations required.
* Work outside in varying temperatures and work conditions.
* Prolonged periods of walking, standing or sitting.

**Physical Demands:**


This position requires:

* Sitting, walking, and standing in a typical medical/clinical office environment.
* Extended and/or prolonged periods of sitting, walking, or standing.
* Regular bending, stretching, and lifting up to 50 pounds.
* Regularly reaching with arms, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling while performing job duties.
* Moderate exposure to unusual elements, such as extreme temperatures, dirt, dust, fumes, smoke, unpleasant odors, and/or loud noises.
* Manual dexterity for tasks involving standard office equipment and computer keyboard, including repetitive movements such as typing.
* Traveling to work sites, including exposure to outside elements.
* Exposure to potentially dangerous materials, hazards, physical risks and situations, requiring adherence to extensive safety precautions and possibly the use of protective equipment.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**


None

new_jobs.description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE


Join Our Community of Food People!


The Supply Chain Training Manager is responsible for overseeing the entirety of Supply Chain onboarding and training (classroom, on\-the\-job, train the trainer, etc.), with emphasis on new\-hire’s (Selectors \& Drivers) first 90\-days. The Supply Chain Training Manager contributes to the continuous improvement of safety, performance standards, ongoing engagement, and retention for new Selectors and Drivers through the implementation of learning and performance solutions (feedback, coaching, mentorship programs) within Supply Chain operations.  

  

In conjunction with Market Operations Leaders, this role mentors lead trainers \& new hires during a multi\-week training program and is responsible for overseeing the assimilation, onboarding, and assessment of new talent. The Supply Chain Training Manager leads, supervises, and conducts associate training needs analysis and identifies opportunities to improve Supply Chain safety, productivity, and retention using observations, data \& analytics, and feedback.**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Owns execution of warehouse training (classroom \& on\-the\-job) for new Selectors \& Drivers during the first 90\-days of employment through coaching and mentoring Selector and Driver Trainers and when necessary and delivery training.
* Leads a team of Supply Chain Trainers \& New Hires through a multi\-week onboarding period (first 90 days) as measured by various indicators (productivity, quality, reliability, safety, culture integration, job knowledge, retention).
* Directs and coordinates all aspects of onboarding and training including scheduling/assigning resources, conducting classroom \& on\-the\-job training when Selector/Driver trainers are not available, performing observations, acting as SME on process \& milestones and metric tracking/success measurements.
* Provides actionable performance, behavioral feedback and coaching in both classroom and on\-the\-job environments to trainers and new hires.
* Facilitates mentoring of new Selectors \& Drivers to drive engagement through the onboarding process.
* Analyzes and tracks weekly Trainer’s \& Associate’s performance (30/60/90\-day milestones) to ensure expectations are met.
* Collects data to determine safety, effectiveness, retention, and sustainability of training for the continuous improvement of the program.
* Ensures both new and existing Associates are safely following preferred plays while meeting productivity goals.
* Partners with Vice President Operations, Directors, HR, and Supervisors/Managers to regularly check progress and performance of new selectors to uncover coaching opportunities and identify steps to improve performance.
* Actively attends and participates in all required routines including but not limited to: UMOS steering, labor planning, and others.
* Reports performance and retention data to HR and L\&D while providing training recommendations and strategies based on trends.
* May consult in the interview, hire, performance review, discipline, and termination process in collaboration with the Vice President of Operations \& HR to ensure all training needs are aligned, relevant, and delivered as expected (as needed).
* Regularly inspects facility for safety hazards and either resolves them or reports them to the safety manager as appropriate. Jointly accountable (with warehouse leadership) for maintaining the physical condition of the warehouse and its equipment.
* Performs all assigned duties for area markets, as needed/requested, which may require travel.
* Performs other duties as assigned by manager.

 **SUPERVISION**:

* Direct supervision of all Selector and Driver New Hires (\~20 new hires at any given time) during their onboarding (Day 1 – Day 90\).
* Market on\-the\-job Trainers, where applicable.

 **RELATIONSHIPS**

* **Internal:** VPO, Directors, HR, and Supervisors/Managers, and Supply Chain Associates
* **External**: Training course vendors and regulatory compliance agencies, as applicable

 **WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Inside/Outside of Distribution Centers, exposure to heat \& cold (freezer \& cooler)
* Internal Associate facing
* Travel via air \& car (rental)

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Two years of training/facilitation experience
* One year experience overseeing a workforce
* Strong leadership, communication, and people development skills

 **Education**

* High School diploma or equivalent

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* College degree
* Training/facilitation experience in a Supply Chain and/or Warehouse environment
* Prior experience and/or leadership/direct supervision in a Supply Chain/Warehouse environment
* Strong facilitation, leadership, communication, engagement, and development skills
* Ability to compile and interpret operational metrics
* Broad knowledge of warehouse operations, methods, and procedures
* Strong computer skills with proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Access

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Operations Manager

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal® is hiring an Operations Manager. The Operations Manager is a central leader in ensuring successful delivery of security services across assigned client sites. This role oversees frontline hiring, staffing, scheduling, training, and operational compliance while serving as a critical support and escalation point for employees and clients. The Operations Manager will champion high‑quality service, workforce stability, and operational consistency by proactively addressing performance concerns, maintaining contractual staffing levels, and building strong client relationships Why Join Allied Universal?
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
Selection and Placement* Manage the selection and placement process for new security professionals, including first\-line supervisors; design and implement career development and performance improvement plans; evaluate low\-performing employees for replacement, upgrade or transfer
* Make initial job offers (for new employees) and job transfers (for existing employees) using company forms and procedures, offering rates, schedules and benefits in alignment with post contract requirements; maintain and publish weekly Open Post List and actively manage job openings within division/branch


Schedule and Workforce Management* Create, modify and manage post schedules in WinTeam to ensure adequate coverage at all times; ensure schedules are properly maintained in WinTeam and are updated regularly
* Ensure all positions are staffed according to contract requirements and effectively manage branch overtime through proper scheduling and staffing; maintain a qualified, sufficient pool of flex personnel for backfill of vacant positions as needed
* Maintain regular proactive contact with Security Professionals to ensure all staff is being effectively utilized, properly trained, and ready for placement as needed. Review “No Hours Report” with branch Human Resource staff on a weekly basis, and disposition employees who are on “active” status with no hours, in accordance with company policies, ensuring no employees remain on “no hours” status beyond 3 weeks


Payroll Management* Receive weekly timesheets and update WinTeam schedules as necessary (verify such for self\-scheduling accounts); run weekly payroll according to company procedures. Ensure records are properly maintained and updated to reduce payroll errors; resolve payroll discrepancies in a timely and efficient manner, and communicate status of such to affected employees, to minimize financial exposure for Company
* Follow all company policies regarding timekeeping procedures, meal and rest period breaks (where applicable), ensuring signatures and acknowledgements are properly documented (where applicable), and conducting weekly audits of timekeeping records to ensure accuracy
* Process requests for final paychecks, anniversary bonuses and other pay related issues, and execute the distribution of such pay; act as a Company representative in such matters as unemployment hearings, workers’ compensation hearings/depositions, union meetings (where applicable), state agency activities, depositions, and other related liability matters


Employee Relations* Conduct disciplinary and counseling sessions with Security Professionals as needed in a proactive and professional manner. Ensure all such issues are documented according to company standards, and that all issues receive proper follow up for resolution
* Initiate termination procedures as needed for voluntary and involuntary separations; execute termination meetings as necessary and complete all follow up documentation according to company standards
* Maintain high employee morale and low employee turnover through effective and proactive communications and timely problem resolution; ensure all hiring, counseling, disciplinary and termination procedures are executed in a consistent manner
* Ensure a smooth running operation by enforcing post specific policies and procedures through proper communication and training; may utilize field training staff to assist in executing post\-specific training

**QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):*** High School diploma or equivalent
* Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle in the course of conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
* Minimum of three (3\) years of leadership experience in a high\-volume workforce environment, preferably in the protective service industry
* Work experience in successfully building and developing teams
* Leadership skills that foster teamwork, innovation, agility, client relations and achieving desired results
* Ability to maintain a profitable book of business by cross\-collaborating and utilizing results\-oriented problem\-solving skills to meet both client and employee growth and satisfaction
* Proficiency in web\-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office and (BI) Business Intelligence tools for metrics analysis, reporting, automation, and presentations
* Dynamic networking skills displaying a commitment to safety and trust by participating in local community, client and industry events
* Basic understanding of financial principles, including budgeting and financial reporting; ability to interpret simple financial data and use it to support decision\-making

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):*** College degree in criminal justice, business administration

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
***About the role:***


The Operations Manager is responsible for reducing risk, responding to incidents, and limiting exposure to liability within the client Global Safety \& Security operations. The Operations Manager will partner with the client Global Safety \& Security Management team to develop, implement and manage physical security, safety, executive protection, special events, investigations and risk management programs that align with the client culture, values and policies. The Operations Manager reports directly to the Director of Operations.  



***In this role, your responsibilities will be:***

* Design, develop, implement, and manage physical security operations for the client including post orders, standards, policies, and procedures
* Maintain close coordination, planning, communication and regular direct liaison with the client Global Safety \& Security management team and SIS Executive team around all aspects of physical security, safety, executive protection, special events, investigations and risk management programs
* Manage operations at local client campus including budget management, performance metrics and contract management
* Responsible for identifying areas of program improvement, expansions of service, customer service improvements and other evolutionary changes
* Create measurable reporting process to include alarm monitoring, incident response, tracking and reporting of performance metrics and other service areas
* Respond in a timely manner to emergent events, issues, staffing deficiencies, and client requests
* Perform other related duties as required

***As a candidate you must have:***

* Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, emergency management, business management, or related discipline or equivalent

new_jobs.description:
VIVAS is a San Francisco signage company. We design, print, fabricate and install signage and large\-format graphics for offices, buildings, retail spaces and events across the Bay Area. Our shop is in the Bayview and our crews work all over the Bay Area.

Half of our work is events and experiential: booths, SEG fabric backdrops, environmental graphics and full venue branding for conferences, activations and large\-scale productions. We're hiring a second Event Project Manager to run events end to end alongside our current PM. In events the date cannot move. Your job is to make sure that on the morning of the event, everything is printed, loaded, delivered and installed — and that nothing about it was a surprise.

**What you'll do**

* Run the project from kickoff to closeout, working backwards from the event date
* Coordinate with venues: load\-in windows, dock access, badges, permits, certificates of insurance
* Keep every job documented and current in Monday, our project system
* Chase artwork through to client approval before it reaches production
* Be on site for install and strike — this is not a desk\-only role
* Close the project out: final walkthrough, photos, and a clean handoff back to the account owner
* Flag a problem the day you see it, not the week of the event

**What we're looking for**

* 2\+ years coordinating events, trade shows, productions, or projects with a hard deadline
* Someone organized enough to hold twenty moving pieces without a single one going quiet
* Comfortable talking to venue operations staff, vendors and clients
* Calm on site when something doesn't match the plan — because it will
* Available for early mornings, evenings and occasional weekends when that's the only install window a venue gives us
* English and Spanish is a strong plus — our shop and crew work in both
* Valid driver's license
* Experience with signage, print or fabrication is a plus, not a requirement — we'll teach you the materials

**What we offer**

* $30\.00 – $35\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Full time, hourly and overtime eligible — we pay for the hours the job actually takes
* Paid sick leave under San Francisco law
* A clear path: this role grows into owning the delivered margin of your projects, not just the delivery
* Work at venues and events you'll recognize across the Bay Area

**Schedule and location**

Based at our shop at 2265 Revere Ave, San Francisco, and on site at venues across the Bay Area. Monday to Friday, with early mornings, evenings and weekends as event load\-ins require. Overtime is paid at the rate California law requires.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed, or at jobs.vivasinc.com — both land in the same inbox. Tell us about one event or project you ran where the date could not move, and what nearly went wrong. We read every application.

Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.

Remote

As the **Revenue Enablement \& Lifecycle Lead at Arango**, you will build the operating system that makes our go\-to\-market organization more productive and repeatable as we scale.


This role will own two critical areas: **seller enablement** and the **renewal/expansion lifecycle**. You will build the playbooks, onboarding, certifications, coaching frameworks, processes, and automation that help our teams generate pipeline, close business, retain customers, and identify expansion opportunities.


You will work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and the field to turn best practices into repeatable execution.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own and continuously improve sales playbooks for our **Commercial, Enterprise, and Federal** teams
* Build and manage a structured **30/60/90\-day onboarding and ramp program** for new sellers
* Partner with Product and Sales Engineering to develop **product, solution, and sales certifications**

* Build a culture of ongoing seller education through recurring training, deal reviews, and field enablement
* Establish a **manager coaching framework** that helps frontline leaders consistently inspect, coach, and improve seller performance
* Measure enablement effectiveness through ramp time, pipeline creation, conversion, productivity, and adoption

### **Renewal \& Expansion Lifecycle**

* Build and operationalize a consistent **180/120/90\-day renewal process**
* Establish the renewal calendar, workflows, ownership, and accountability required to proactively manage the install base
* Partner with RevOps and Customer Success to automate and surface **usage, health, engagement, risk, and renewal signals**
* Develop repeatable renewal and expansion playbooks based on customer behavior and account signals
* Create processes for identifying **expansion triggers** and routing opportunities to the appropriate seller
* Establish best practices for renewal forecasting, risk identification, customer engagement, and escalation
* Continuously identify opportunities to **automate manual lifecycle processes** and improve visibility across the customer base
* Define and track the KPIs required to measure renewal execution, retention, expansion, and seller productivity

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in **sales enablement, revenue enablement, revenue operations, customer lifecycle operations, or related GTM functions**
* Experience building scalable sales processes and enablement programs within a **B2B SaaS organization**
* Demonstrated experience improving **seller productivity, pipeline generation, deal execution, renewals, or expansion**
* Strong understanding of modern sales methodologies such as **MEDDPICC**
* Experience designing workflows, processes, and automation across CRM and GTM systems
* Ability to translate successful field behavior into **repeatable playbooks and operating processes**
* Strong cross\-functional leadership skills with the ability to work across Sales, Customer Success, RevOps, Product, and Marketing
* Strong communication, facilitation, and program\-management skills
* Experience driving adoption and behavioral change across a growing sales organization


**What Makes Arango Special?**
------------------------------


At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.


Working at Arango means:

* Contributing to cutting\-edge AI and data infrastructure
* Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
* Helping shape how enterprises build AI\-powered applications


If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

new_jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.  


At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.  


As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.  


Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.  


The Role  


As a Product Manager for Veeva Clinical Operations, you will drive core features and enhancements for key applications that are transforming how the life sciences industry runs clinical trials. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, you will help execute the product vision to unify clinical systems, streamline trial execution, and speed the delivery of new therapies to patients.  


What You'll Do  
Execute the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for specific features within the Vault Clinical Operations suite, from concept to release and iteration.  
Engage directly with customers, domain experts, and internal stakeholders to gather business requirements and understand clinical workflows.  
Author clear feature specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for Engineering, QA, and UX design teams.  
Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing customer requests, enhancements, and strategic initiatives.  
Serve as an application expert, educating Sales, Solution Consultants, Professional Services, and Support teams through documentation and product demos.  
Track key usage metrics to evaluate feature performance and inform data\-driven product decisions.  
Stay aligned with regulatory guidelines and industry updates impacting clinical trial management.  
Requirements  
3\+ years of Product Management experience, preferably within B2B enterprise SaaS applications.  
Proven track record of managing product features through the development lifecycle to successful launch.  
Experience working within an agile software development environment.  
Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills with the ability to articulate clear product requirements.  
Analytical mindset with strong problem\-solving capabilities.  
Commitment to professional integrity and ethical decision\-making.  
Ability to travel up to 15% for customer research and internal events.  
Nice to Have  
Domain knowledge in clinical operations (e.g., eTMF, CTMS, SSU, or CDMS) from a pharma, biotech, CRO, or life sciences technology vendor.  
Experience in regulated industries (e.g., GCP, 21 CFR Part 11\).  
Familiarity with the Veeva Vault Platform.  
Interviewing with Veeva  


We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.  


Follow the application process and submit your resume.  
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.  
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.  
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:  
A conversation with the hiring manager  
A practical case exercise  
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.  
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.  
Perks \& Benefits  
Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance  
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays  
Retirement programs  
1% charitable giving program

Base pay: $75,000 \- $165,000  
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

new_jobs.title: Fiber Splicing Project Manager Nationwide
new_jobs.description:
**About Pacific Tech Communication**

Pacific Tech Communication (PTC) is a growing national telecommunications infrastructure contractor delivering OSP fiber construction, splicing, and related services for Tier 1 and Tier 2 providers. We are hiring a Fiber Splicing Project Manager to own splicing operations from crew assignment through close\-out, billing, and customer delivery.

**Position Summary**

The Fiber Splicing Project Manager plans, schedules, and leads fiber splicing crews and subcontractors across active markets. This is a working leadership role responsible for production, quality, safety, training, customer communication, and accurate billing. Significant travel to job sites and customer markets is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Crew Scheduling \& Resource Management**

* Build and maintain daily, weekly, and look\-ahead crew schedules for in\-house splicers and subcontractors.
* Assign work by skill level, equipment, location, and customer priority; balance multiple concurrent projects.
* Coordinate mobilization, lodging, vehicles, trailers, fusion splicers, OTDRs, and materials so crews arrive ready to produce.
* Adjust schedules for weather, customer change orders, restoration work, and night/weekend cutovers.
* Track headcount, production units, and capacity; flag resource gaps early.

**Training \& Crew Development**

* Onboard new splicers and leads; verify competency on fusion splicing, ribbon fiber, enclosures, testing, and documentation.
* Deliver and document field training on company methods, customer specs, and quality standards.
* Mentor junior splicers; evaluate performance and recommend promotions, coaching, or corrective action.
* Maintain training records and support certification paths (FOA/ETA or equivalent preferred).

**Safety \& Compliance**

* Enforce OSHA, NESC, DOT, and company safety requirements on every job.
* Ensure daily tailgates/JSAs, PPE, traffic control, and confined space/aerial practices are completed and documented.
* Conduct field safety observations and stop work when conditions are unsafe.
* Support incident reporting, near\-miss capture, and corrective actions.

**Billing, Production Tracking \& Close\-Out**

* Capture daily production (splices, enclosures, footage, testing, restoration) against contract units or T\&M.
* Review timesheets, per diem, material tickets, and subcontractor invoices for accuracy before submission.
* Prepare and submit billing packages, as\-builts, OTDR/OLTS results, and customer close\-out documentation on time.
* Resolve billing discrepancies with operations, accounting, and the customer.
* Protect project margin by controlling overtime, rework, idle time, and material waste.

**Customer Relationship \& Communication**

* Serve as the primary field contact for customer construction managers, inspectors, and NOC/restoration teams.
* Provide clear daily/weekly progress updates, forecasts, and issue escalation.
* Walk jobs with the customer; resolve punch\-list and quality items quickly.
* Protect customer relationships during outages, cutovers, and schedule conflicts.
* Coordinate with internal project managers, construction leads, and engineering on prints, splice matrices, and cut sheets.

**Travel \& Field Presence**

* Travel regularly across assigned markets and projects (expected 80%\+ depending on workload), including overnight and multi\-week assignments.
* Be present on critical splices, large cutovers, restorations, and customer ride\-outs.
* Support night work, weekends, and on\-call restoration as project and customer needs require.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to operate or travel with company vehicles required.

**Qualifications**

* 8\+ years hands\-on fiber optic splicing experience (OSP aerial, underground, and/or FTTH).
* 5\+ years supervising splicers, leads, or subcontract splicing crews.
* Proven ability to read splice diagrams, construction prints, and fiber assignment records.
* Working knowledge of fusion splicers, OTDR, power meter/OLTS, and acceptance testing standards.
* Experience with production tracking, unit billing or T\&M billing, and close\-out packages.
* Strong safety record and familiarity with OSHA field requirements.
* Clear written and verbal communication with crews and customers.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook) and willingness to use company scheduling/field apps.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; FOA CFOT/CFOS or equivalent a plus.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively; valid U.S. driver’s license; acceptable MVR.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting Tier 1/2 providers (Lumen, AT\&T, Charter, or similar).
* Prior work in multi\-state contractor environments.
* OSHA 10/30, First Aid/CPR.
* Bilingual English/Spanish/Russian a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.
* Opportunity to build and lead splicing operations on national carrier work.
* Direct visibility with operations leadership.
* Benefits details provided during the interview process.

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

License/Certification:

* Driver License (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: Remote
