new_jobs.description:
**Title**POS Project Manager  

  

Merchant Boarding \& Business Services – POS
**Reports to**
  

  

POS Manager, Professional Services
**About Payroc**
  

  

Payroc is a global payments technology company helping businesses get paid, grow faster, and operate smarter. From powerful POS systems to seamless online and mobile payment solutions, we equip merchants with the tools they need to succeed in today’s fast\-moving commerce landscape.
At Payroc, our culture is built around people who lead with grit, take ownership, and are not afraid to be a boss when it comes to driving results. We believe the best solutions start when we listen first to our customers, our partners, and each other so we can deliver payment experiences that truly make a difference for the businesses we serve.
We are a team that moves quickly, thinks entrepreneurially, and celebrates big wins together. If you are energized by building relationships, solving real business problems, and creating opportunities for yourself and your clients, Payroc is the kind of place where you can make an impact and grow your career.
**Position Overview**
  

  

The POS Project Manager is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role that goes beyond traditional project management by actively overseeing and supporting the installation, configuration, and deployment of POS and payment solutions. Serving as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation lifecycle, this individual coordinates project timelines, manages cross\-functional teams, and works directly with merchants to ensure a seamless onboarding and successful go\-live.
The ideal candidate combines strong project coordination skills with technical knowledge of POS systems and payment processing. They are comfortable managing multiple implementations while assisting with system configuration, hardware staging, installations, merchant training, troubleshooting, and ensuring a smooth transition to ongoing support.
**Duties and Responsibilities*** Drive successful implementations tracking milestones, timelines and dependencies to ensure timely execution of projects. Document tasks and communication in project management software to ensure accountability and transparency. Identify risk, critical paths, forecast delays, and implement contingency plans. Proactively manage blockers and escalate when necessary.
* Coordinate between key stakeholders to translate and align technical requirements. Ensure scope, timelines, and system capabilities are met. Conduct structured meetings using agendas and action trackers.
* Analyze, design, build and customize merchant menu and retail databases to support complex hospitality and retail use cases, such as multi\-revenue center setups, timed promotions, and tiered pricing.
* Participate in testing and validation of database configurations (database review) prior to go\-live, ensuring alignment with client expectations and operational readiness.
* Perform end\-to\-end hardware and software imaging and staging to ensure proper configuration, testing, and readiness for deployment
* Execute remote and on\-site installations ensuring all POS technologies (e.g., terminals, printers, payment peripherals) are configured with merchant\-specific settings. Validate site installation readiness using connectivity tests and checklist audits prior to installation and in alignment with merchant go\-live targets. Coordinate with logistics and field service teams to align installations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware, and network configuration issues throughout implementation and post\-deployment phases.
* Train and assist merchant staff during go\-live, offering real\-time troubleshooting, operational guidance, and best practices for POS usage.
* Ensure a smooth handoff from implementation to ongoing support. Monitor and resolve post\-deployment issues during live transition including database configurations, technical blockers, and training.
**Qualifications*** 3–5 years of project management experience, preferably in POS systems, SaaS onboarding, or payment processing within the payment or hospitality/retail technology industry
* Strong knowledge of restaurant and retail POS platforms (e.g., Clover, Revel, Lightspeed, Toast) and related hardware
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and collaborative approach
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with strong attention to detail
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Monday.com, Jira, or similar project tracking software
* PMP, Scrum, or Agile certifications are a plus
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Project Management, or a related field preferred
**Working Conditions*** Combination of office\-based, remote, and customer\-site work, depending on implementation schedules and business needs.
* Regular travel to customer locations for on\-site installations, training, and implementation support, including occasional overnight travel as business needs require.
* Frequent handling, movement, and setup of POS hardware and related equipment. This role may require moving equipment weighing up to 25 pounds as part of installation and deployment activities, with or without reasonable accommodation.
**Travel Component**
  

  

* 10\-15%

**Equality**
  

  

At Payroc we are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individuals’ qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, national social or ethnic origin, sex, age, physical, mental, or sensory disability, sexual orientation or any other status protected by the laws regulation in the location we operate. Payroc does not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

The Project Coordinator provides flexible, cross\-functional support across all TSA recruitment marketing and advertising contract activities. Working closely with the Program Manager and workstream leads, the role helps wherever needed to keep day\-to\-day execution moving, including recruitment marketing and advertising, creative development, media and job board activities, events and logistics, performance reporting, quality control, client coordination, documentation, and transition support. new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Support Manager, Enterprise
new_jobs.description:
**Why Mozilla?**

Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open\-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**About this team and role:**

Mozilla’s Customer Experience team helps users, organizations, and partners successfully adopt, use, and get sustained value from Mozilla products. Historically, much of Mozilla’s support work has focused on consumers. As Mozilla expands its business and organizational offerings, we are building a support operation designed for the needs of B2B customers, including dependable service delivery, clear customer commitments, global coverage, and close coordination with Product and Engineering.



As Staff Enterprise Support Operations Manager, you will be Mozilla’s first dedicated B2B support operations leader. You will not inherit a mature operation; you will build one. You will design and launch the operating model, vendor strategy, processes, tooling, training, metrics, capacity planning, and governance required to provide high\-quality technical support to organizations deploying and managing Mozilla products.



Beyond building the support operation, you will serve as the operational bridge between Enterprise customers, CX, Product, and Engineering, ensuring insights from customers and support teams inform the broader Enterprise experience.



This is an individual contributor role with broad end\-to\-end ownership. You will be the day\-to\-day owner of Mozilla’s external B2B support vendor relationships and the operational processes connecting vendor agents with Mozilla teams. As the business grows, you will also help define the structure and capabilities of Mozilla’s future B2B support team.



You will participate in a defined incident coverage model and periodically lead the operational response to major customer incidents. In those moments, you will ensure vendors follow established procedures, coordinate escalation and handoffs to Mozilla engineers, drive cross\-functional resolution, communicate clearly with customers and internal leaders, and oversee post\-incident reviews and root cause analysis.



This position requires a rare combination of support operations expertise, vendor management, program development, technical fluency, and calm leadership under pressure. Our ideal candidate is a practical builder who can move between strategy and execution, create structure where none exists, and earn the trust of customers, vendors, engineers, and senior leaders.


**What you’ll do:**
* Build and launch Mozilla’s first B2B support operations capability, including its operating model, workflows, escalation paths, governance, and continuous\-improvement processes.
* Own external support vendor relationships end to end, including future vendor selection and contracting support, onboarding, workforce planning, performance management, invoicing, renewals, and investment recommendations.
* Create and maintain vendor training, support playbooks, standard operating procedures, quality frameworks, knowledge materials, and coordination with product teams for release\-readiness plans.
* Forecast customer demand and support capacity, balancing staffing, coverage, language needs, service quality, cost, and business growth; recommend when to expand into new geographies or service models.
* Define service objectives, metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and operating reviews for quality, speed, customer experience, productivity, and cost.
* Hold vendors accountable for performance, identify service gaps, and lead corrective\-action and continuous\-improvement plans.
* Own Mozilla’s operational enterprise escalation framework while designing and managing operational handoffs between vendor agents and Mozilla teams so complex issues reach the right Engineering, Product, Security, or business partners with sufficient context and urgency.
* Lead the operational response to major B2B incidents, coordinating vendor execution, engineering engagement, customer and leadership communications, resolution, and post\-incident review.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and other teams to align customer commitments with operational capacity and improve the support experience.
* Participate in customer\-facing meetings to understand operational challenges, explain support processes, gather feedback, and strengthen the customer support experience.

new_jobs.description:
Department Overview:

This position is responsible for managed care, insurance verification and patient price estimate processes within the Centralized Managed Care \& Price Estimates (CMC) department. This position supports the OHSU systems and operations of ambulatory practices, professional services and hospital departments. This position works closely with internal and external customers including Intake Coordinators, Clinical Staff, Surgery Schedulers, Care Managers, Financial Counselors, Insurance Companies, PCP Office Staff, and CMC Leadership to ensure patients receive optimal financial services related to their care.  

The Managed Care Coordinator and Insurance Verification \& Patient Estimates Specialist are an integral part of the CMC team by providing clear and accurate information regarding our patients' financial obligations related to their visits, treatments, procedures and/or hospital admissions. This role is responsible for obtaining and/or verifying prior authorizations, verifying benefits, creating cost estimates, contacting patients to provide estimates, offer pre\-service payment opportunity and collecting pre\-service payments for visits, treatments, procedures and/or hospital admissions. This position is also responsible for providing guidance for other staff in the areas of patient liabilities, health care contract terms, complex patient referrals, and other managed care issues.  

The incumbent will have an extensive knowledge of Managed Care and Insurance Verification processes in the ambulatory and inpatient setting including but not limited to insurance eligibility, benefits verification and authorization requirements. This role is knowledgeable about the Epic system and current best practice referral and prior authorization workflows. The incumbent is able to provide support and backup to the Centralized Managed Care \& Price Estimates Department as needed for cross\-coverage for all managed care and insurance verification workflows.

Document any details related to liability insurance (i.e. motor vehicle accident, personal injury, or worker’s compensation) to determine third party liability.

* Document information based on department protocols in the Epic Referral shell.
* Work closely with referring providers to obtain necessary insurance referrals and authorizations.
* For urgent/emergent admissions, provides admit information and sets up authorizations and/or PCP referrals. Contacts care\-management to provide clinical review and obtain length of stay.
* For routine admissions, confirms that the authorizations and/or PCP referrals cover the designated admission. If authorizations and/or PCP referrals are not noted in the system, contacts the Managed Care Coordinator from specialist’s office requesting the admission for follow up with the designated insurance company.
* Send notification of admission for urgent admissions.
* When appropriate, obtain authorizations for all clinical care, procedures, diagnostic studies, medications, outpatient infusion treatment, and inpatient admissions including notifying insurance upon admission.
* Follow up on all pending authorizations and/or PCP referrals until accounts are secured.
* Maintains current information on managed care insurance plans and serves as a liaison and information resource for patients, referring physician offices, and other OHSU staff. Applies problem solving and negotiating skills in resolving patient concerns and managed care related issues.
* Collects detailed information of trauma admissions (motor vehicle accident, personal injury, and/or worker’s compensation) to determine accident\-related liability.
* Appropriately codes insurance plans in EPIC system for billing purposes.
* Work directly with insurance companies, the denial coordinator and the clinical staff and/or provider to supply necessary information to appeal denied claims and/or authorization requests as applicable.
* Appropriately code insurance plans within EPIC system for billing purposes.
* Provide backup support for other Managed Care coordinators within the Centralized Managed Care \& Price Estimates department.
* For self\-pay patients, complete duties associated with financial assistance determinations such as above/below the line. Including connecting patients with necessary social work or financial counseling to assist in the coverage process.
* Complete necessary forms prior to upcoming procedures, admissions, and/or appointments (i.e. Non\-Covered Charges Form (NCCF), Advanced Beneficiary Notification (ABN) or Patient Financial Estimate (FE)) as required.

**Patient Liability Estimates*** Review work queue for patients that need an estimate created.
* Document information based on department protocols in the Epic referral shell.
* Create a Patient Liability Estimate.
* Complete accurate pre\-registration via phone as applicable.
* Contact the patient prior to service to inform them of their estimate and collect any pre\-payments at that time.


Other duties as assigned.

Genius Academy is an AI\-powered education company helping students build real\-world professional skills through immersive simulations. Our experiences place learners in realistic scenarios where they develop the confidence and judgment needed to navigate complex human situations.

We partner with colleges and universities across the country to bring these experiences into academic programs, preparing the next generation of professionals in counseling, social work, psychology, and nursing.

**What we are looking for**

* Highly organized individual, with a track record of running multiple projects at once and staying on top of the details.
* Comfortable working across project tracking tools such as Asana, Airtable, and Notion, and quick to learn new ones.
* Strong written communication. Much of this role is clear, concise writing to colleagues and external partners.
* Comfortable using AI tools as part of everyday work.
* Experience coordinating across teams, functions, or external partners.
* \[Nice to have] Experience with vendor management, business compliance, or expense administration.

**Where and when**

* This is a fully remote role, open to candidates in any location.
* Core hours overlap with US business hours and the role requires regular attendance at meetings scheduled in US time zones.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a short note about why this role interests you to .

The Operations Associate supports the day\-to\-day running of Genius Academy across operations, production coordination, and content support. The role works with people across the company and reports to the VP of Operations \& People.

**Working principle**

**If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!**


We are seeking an ERP Business Analyst to translate Army finance and operational needs into clear processes, requirements, and acceptance criteria for a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F\&O) implementation. The solution includes Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management. This posting supports D365 F\&O business analysis and broader business\-process improvement assignments. Candidates must meet the requirements for their assigned specialty; experience across both specialties is not required.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Facilitate discovery workshops with finance, property, supply, reporting, and technical stakeholders.
* Document current and future workflows, controls, role ownership, handoffs, exceptions, and performance measures.
* Translate approved needs into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized delivery backlog.
* Maintain traceability among business objectives, process decisions, configuration requirements, tests, and release evidence.
* For D365 F\&O assignments, conduct fit\-to\-standard and fit\-gap analysis and document approved configuration needs.
* For process\-focused assignments, analyze root causes, redesign cross\-functional processes, and define measurable improvements and operating procedures.
* Support human\-centered design, user acceptance testing, defect clarification, adoption planning, and business readiness.
* Coordinate policy and process decisions with accountable Government owners and support a configuration\-first implementation approach.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:**

* 5\+ years of experience in business analysis or process improvement, including 3\+ years supporting ERP, financial systems, or enterprise transformation.
* Experience facilitating workshops and developing process models, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to analyze business controls, identify root causes, and maintain requirement\-to\-test traceability.
* Experience supporting implementation testing, user acceptance testing, and stakeholder review of proposed changes.
* For D365 F\&O assignments, hands\-on participation in a D365 F\&O implementation and knowledge of financial transaction lifecycles and reconciliation.

**EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, accounting, finance, information systems, industrial engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of relevant education, training, and professional experience.

new_jobs.title: Research Operations Specialist - Contracts, Vendors & Spend
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**


We're looking for an experienced Research Operations Specialist to own the contracts, vendor relationships, and spending behind a research team of roughly sixty researchers and a portfolio of about fifty active research agencies and research tool vendors. In this hands\-on individual contributor role, you'll:


* guide contracts from project request through signed agreement,
* serve as the team's go\-to partner for Finance on budgets and forecasts,
* give researchers clear visibility into where their projects stand.

You'll join a small research operations team with real room to streamline how work gets done, including through the use of AI tools.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Execute contracts end to end: once a researcher raises a project, guide it through scoping, statement of work, approvals, and kickoff.
* Represent researchers in scoping and negotiation. Translate study needs into clear commercial terms and make confident calls that limit unnecessary back\-and\-forth.
* Partner closely with Finance and research leads on budgeting and forecasting so leads know how they're tracking against budget throughout the year. This includes spend tracking, quarterly forecasts, and monthly budget reviews.
* Maintain a clear, current view of all active contracts, onboarding, and approvals, and proactively keep researchers informed on status and next steps.
* Manage spend requests from intake through approval in Zip and Oracle, including purchase orders, change orders, invoices, and requisitions.
* Onboard and offboard vendors and tools from start to finish. This covers supplier questionnaires, NDAs, risk and privacy reviews, legal routing, and tool access and integrations.
* Coordinate master service agreements, statements of work, NDAs, and renewals with Legal and Procurement. Adapt to the differing legal, procurement, and data requirements of international markets, including EMEA and China.
* Maintain the contract repository, retainer trackers, and master supplier list.
* Track renewals at 30, 60, and 90 days, and support the transition of vendors and agencies to retainer\-based models.
* Support vendor evaluation and consolidation, including reviewing data\-use, model\-training, and data processing terms for AI tools.
* Serve as the team's primary point of contact with Legal, Privacy, Security, Procurement, Sourcing, Finance, and Accounts Payable.
* Anticipate and resolve review bottlenecks, set clear timeline expectations with researchers, and escalate early when reviews stall.
* Maintain the team's operating data in Airtable and support knowledge management across the shared drive, research repository, and team tools.

**Qualifications**


*Required*


* 7\+ years of experience in procurement, contract administration, or vendor operations; 10\+ years is ideal.
* Strong contract\-reading judgment. You can understand terms, spot gaps or risks early, and know when to involve Legal.
* Experience with contracting and procurement across global markets, including how legal, privacy, and procurement requirements differ by region.
* Hands\-on experience with procure\-to\-pay systems, ideally Zip and Oracle. Candidates with strong experience on comparable platforms, such as Coupa, who learn new systems quickly will be considered.
* A systems\-minded approach: you see the full lifecycle from intake to contract to spend, get ahead of problems, and find ways to work more efficiently.
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with clear, proactive communication with researchers, finance partners, and vendors.

*Preferred*


* A legal or contracts\-focused background, such as paralegal or contract management experience.
* Experience working in or alongside research teams, particularly UX research, market research, or consumer insights.
* Hands\-on Airtable experience, including automations.
* Experience with Salesforce and DocuSign.
* Day\-to\-day use of AI tools, ideally including building automations, agents, or AI\-assisted workflows.

**Key Details**


* Start Date: October 19, 2026
* Duration: Estimated through December 31, 2027
* Location: Remote (within the U.S.)
* Work Schedule: Part\-time, 30 hours per week (6 hours per day, Monday\-Friday), with occasional flexibility needed to support international partners
* Pay Rate: $100\-$114 per hour \+ benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k)
* Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* Engagement: W2 Contract role through Maleda Tech.
